71	        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
72	            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
73	            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
74	                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
75	                return
76	            fi
77	        fi
78	    done
79	    echo "0"
80	}
81	
82	get_time_ms() {
83	    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
84	    local sec=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f1)
85	    local frac=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f2)
86	    frac=$(echo "$frac" | cut -c1-2)
87	    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
88	    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
89	    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
90	}
91	
92	# ============================================
93	# CPU-bound 工作负载
94	# 核心思想：使用大量寄存器操作，减少内存访问
95	# 纯 ALU 运算，让性能真正跟随频率变化
96	# ============================================
97	
98	cpu_workload() {
99	    local n=$1
100	    # 多变量交替运算，全部在寄存器中完成
101	    local a=1 b=2 c=3 d=4 e=5 f=6 g=7 h=8
102	    local i=0
103	    while [ $i -lt $n ]; do
104	        a=$(( (a * 3 + b) & 0xFFFF ))
105	        b=$(( (b * 5 + c) & 0xFFFF ))
106	        c=$(( (c * 7 + d) & 0xFFFF ))
107	        d=$(( (d * 11 + e) & 0xFFFF ))
108	        e=$(( (e * 13 + f) & 0xFFFF ))
109	        f=$(( (f * 17 + g) & 0xFFFF ))
110	        g=$(( (g * 19 + h) & 0xFFFF ))
111	        h=$(( (h * 23 + a) & 0xFFFF ))
112	        i=$((i + 1))
113	    done
114	    echo "$a"
115	}
116	
117	# 修复 sysfs 文件权限（诊断发现 max_freq 和 governor 是只读的）
118	fix_sysfs_perms() {
119	    local policy=$1
120	    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
121	
122	    # scaling_max_freq 默认 r--r--r-- (system:system)，需要加写权限
123	    chmod 664 "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
124	    # scaling_governor 默认 r--r--r-- (root:root)
125	    chmod 664 "$base/scaling_governor" 2>/dev/null
126	    # boost 接口
127	    chmod 664 "$base/boost" 2>/dev/null
128	}
129	
130	lock_freq() {
131	    local policy=$1
132	    local freq=$2
133	    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
134	
135	    # 关闭 boost
136	    echo 0 > "$base/boost" 2>/dev/null
137	
138	    # 策略1：同时写 max 和 min（锁定到精确频率）
139	    if [ "$MAX_WRITABLE" = "1" ]; then
140	        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
141	        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
142	        sleep 0.5
143	
144	        local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
145	        local lower=$((freq * 95 / 100))
146	        local upper=$((freq * 105 / 100))
147	        if [ "$actual" -ge "$lower" ] && [ "$actual" -le "$upper" ] 2>/dev/null; then
148	            return 0
149	        fi
150	    fi
151	
152	    # 策略2：只写 min（至少达到目标频率）
153	    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
154	    sleep 0.5
155	
156	    local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
157	    # 只用 min 时，频率可能高于目标，接受 >= 目标的 95%
158	    local lower=$((freq * 95 / 100))
159	    if [ "$actual" -ge "$lower" ] 2>/dev/null; then
160	        return 0
161	    fi
162	
163	    return 1
164	}
165	
166	unlock_freq() {
167	    local policy=$1
168	    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
169	    local min_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_min_freq" 2>/dev/null)
170	    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
171	    echo "$min_avail" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
172	    echo "$max_avail" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
173	}
174	
175	get_available_freqs() {
176	    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
177	}
178	
179	bind_cpus() {
180	    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null
181	}
182	
183	sample_current() {
184	    local samples=$1
185	    local sum=0
186	    local i=0
187	    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
188	        local c=$(read_current)
189	        sum=$((sum + c))
190	        sleep 0.3
191	        i=$((i + 1))
192	    done
193	    echo $((sum / samples))
194	}
195	
196	# ============================================
197	# 校准测试：确认工作负载是 CPU-bound
198	# 策略：跑两次不同迭代数，检查时间比例
199	# ============================================
200	
201	calibrate() {
202	    log "校准工作负载..."
203	
204	    # 锁定到中等频率
205	    lock_freq "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
206	    bind_cpus "$MID_CPUS"
207	    sleep 1
208	
209	    # 小批量
210	    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
211	    cpu_workload 100000 > /dev/null
212	    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
213	    local ms_small=$((t2 - t1))
214	
215	    # 大批量
216	    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
217	    cpu_workload 500000 > /dev/null
218	    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
219	    local ms_large=$((t4 - t3))
220	
221	    unlock_freq "$MID_POLICY"
222	
223	    local ratio=$((ms_large * 100 / ms_small))
224	    log "  100k迭代: ${ms_small}ms | 500k迭代: ${ms_large}ms | 比例: ${ratio}%"
225	
226	    # 理想比例应该是 ~500%
227	    if [ "$ratio" -gt 300 ] && [ "$ratio" -lt 700 ]; then
228	        log "  ✓ 工作负载可扩展性良好 (${ratio}%)"
229	    elif [ "$ratio" -gt 200 ]; then
230	        log "  ⚠ 工作负载可扩展性一般 (${ratio}%)"
231	    else
232	        log "  ✗ 工作负载可扩展性差 (${ratio}%)，结果可能不准确"
233	    fi
234	    log ""
235	
236	    # 选择合适的迭代数：目标每轮 ~50ms
237	    local iter_per_ms=$((500000 / (ms_large + 1)))
238	    local target_iters=$((iter_per_ms * 50))
239	    # 下取整到万
240	    target_iters=$((target_iters / 10000 * 10000))
241	    [ "$target_iters" -lt 10000 ] && target_iters=10000
242	    [ "$target_iters" -gt 1000000 ] && target_iters=1000000
243	
244	    log "  推荐每轮迭代数: $target_iters (目标 ~50ms/轮)"
245	    WORKLOAD_ITERS=$target_iters
246	}
247	
248	# ============================================
249	# 单次测试
250	# ============================================
251	
252	run_single_test() {
253	    local policy=$1
254	    local freq=$2
255	    local cpus=$3
256	    local label="$4"
257	
258	    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
259	    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"
260	
261	    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"
262	    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
263	        log "  跳过: 无法锁定"
264	        return 1
265	    fi
266	
267	    local actual_freq=$(cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
268	    log "  锁定: $((actual_freq/1000))MHz"
269	
270	    bind_cpus "$cpus"
271	    sleep 0.5
272	
273	    # 基线功耗
274	    log "  采样基线..."
275	    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
276	    local base_temp=$(read_temp)
277	
278	    # 运行负载
279	    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s (每轮${WORKLOAD_ITERS}次)..."
280	    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
281	    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
282	    local total_iters=0
283	    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
284	        cpu_workload $WORKLOAD_ITERS > /dev/null
285	        total_iters=$((total_iters + WORKLOAD_ITERS))
286	    done
287	    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
288	    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))
289	
290	    # 负载功耗
291	    log "  采样负载..."
292	    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
293	    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
294	    local voltage=$(read_voltage)
295	
296	    # 功耗计算 (避免溢出)
297	    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
298	    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
299	    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
300	    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
301	    local power_mw=$((ma * v))
302	
303	    # 性能 = 每秒千次迭代
304	    local iters_per_sec=0
305	    if [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ]; then
306	        iters_per_sec=$((total_iters * 1000 / elapsed_ms))
307	    fi
308	    local perf_k=$((iters_per_sec / 1000))
309	
310	    # 能效比 = 每毫瓦的千次迭代/秒
311	    local efficiency=0
312	    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
313	        efficiency=$((perf_k * 100 / power_mw))
314	    fi
315	
316	    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_k,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"
317	
318	    log "  结果: 性能=${perf_k}k/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=${efficiency} | 温度 ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"
319	    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
320	    sleep $COOL_DOWN
321	    return 0
322	}
323	
324	# ============================================
325	# 主流程
326	# ============================================
327	
328	main() {
329	    log "=========================================="
330	    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v3"
331	    log "=========================================="
332	
333	    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
334	        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
335	        exit 1
336	    fi
337	
338	    # SELinux 处理
339	    local selinux_mode=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
340	    log "SELinux 模式: $selinux_mode"
341	    if [ "$selinux_mode" = "Enforcing" ]; then
342	        log "切换 SELinux 到 Permissive 模式..."
343	        setenforce 0
344	        local new_mode=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
345	        log "SELinux 已切换到: $new_mode"
346	    fi
347	    log ""
348	
349	    # 修复 sysfs 权限（诊断发现 max_freq 和 governor 是只读的）
350	    log "修复 sysfs 文件权限..."
351	    fix_sysfs_perms "$MID_POLICY"
352	    fix_sysfs_perms "$BIG_POLICY"
353	
354	    # 验证写入
355	    local test_file="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_min_freq"
356	    local orig_val=$(cat "$test_file" 2>/dev/null)
357	    echo "$orig_val" > "$test_file" 2>/dev/null
358	    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
359	        log "错误: 无法写入 sysfs ($test_file)"
360	        exit 1
361	    fi
362	
363	    # 验证 governor 写入
364	    local gov_file="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_governor"
365	    local orig_gov=$(cat "$gov_file" 2>/dev/null)
366	    echo "$orig_gov" > "$gov_file" 2>/dev/null
367	    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
368	        log "警告: 无法写入 governor，将使用当前 governor"
369	        GOV_WRITABLE=0
370	    else
371	        GOV_WRITABLE=1
372	    fi
373	
374	    # 验证 max_freq 写入
375	    local max_file="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_max_freq"
376	    local orig_max=$(cat "$max_file" 2>/dev/null)
377	    echo "$orig_max" > "$max_file" 2>/dev/null
378	    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
379	        log "警告: 无法写入 max_freq，只能用 min_freq 锁频"
380	        MAX_WRITABLE=0
381	    else
382	        MAX_WRITABLE=1
383	    fi
384	
385	    log "权限检查: governor=${GOV_WRITABLE} max_freq=${MAX_WRITABLE} min_freq=1"
386	    log ""
387	
388	    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
389	        log "错误: 无法读取电流"
390	        exit 1
391	    fi
392	
393	    enable_screen_on
394	    log "初始温度: $(read_temp)°C"
395	    log "CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
396	    log "LOG: $LOG_FILE"
397	    log ""
398	
399	    # 校准
400	    calibrate
401	
402	    # CSV 头 (增加实际频率列)
403	    echo "核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,性能k/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"
404	
405	    # Governor（需要先 chmod）
406	    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
407	    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
408	    log "Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"
409	
410	    if [ "$GOV_WRITABLE" = "1" ]; then
411	        echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
412	        echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
413	        local cur_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
414	        local cur_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
415	        log "已切换: 中核=$cur_gov_mid 大核=$cur_gov_big"
416	    else
417	        log "Governor 不可写，使用当前 governor: $orig_gov_mid / $orig_gov_big"
418	    fi
419	    log ""
420	
421	    # ---- 中核 ----
422	    log "====== 中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
423	    local mid_ok=0
424	    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
425	        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核" && mid_ok=$((mid_ok + 1))
426	    done
427	    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
428	    log "中核完成: $mid_ok 个"
429	    log ""
430	
431	    # ---- 大核 ----
432	    log "====== 大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
433	    local big_ok=0
434	    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
435	        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核" && big_ok=$((big_ok + 1))
436	    done
437	    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
438	    log "大核完成: $big_ok 个"
439	    log ""
440	
441	    # 恢复 governor
442	    if [ "$GOV_WRITABLE" = "1" ]; then
443	        echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
444	        echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
445	        log "已恢复 Governor"
446	    fi
447	    restore_screen
448	
449	    # 恢复 SELinux
450	    if [ "$selinux_mode" = "Enforcing" ]; then
451	        setenforce 1
452	        log "已恢复 SELinux 为 Enforcing"
453	    fi
454	
455	    log "=========================================="
456	    log "  完成! 温度: $(read_temp)°C"
457	    log "  CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
458	    log "=========================================="
459	}
460	
461	main "$@"

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试脚本 v3
# 改进：使用 CPU-bound 工作负载，避开内存瓶颈
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/energy_bench_v3.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

mkdir -p "$SCRIPT_DIR"

# ============================================
# 屏幕常亮控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

enable_screen_on() {
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null
    log "屏幕常亮已开启 (最低亮度)"
}

restore_screen() {
    [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ] && settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ] && settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    log "屏幕设置已恢复"
}

# ============================================
# 配置区
# ============================================

MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

BENCH_DURATION=10
COOL_DOWN=5

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    if [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo $((0 - raw))
    else
        echo "$raw"
    fi
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    local sec=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f1)
    local frac=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f2)
    frac=$(echo "$frac" | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

# ============================================
# CPU-bound 工作负载
# 核心思想：使用大量寄存器操作，减少内存访问
# 纯 ALU 运算，让性能真正跟随频率变化
# ============================================

cpu_workload() {
    local n=$1
    # 多变量交替运算，全部在寄存器中完成
    local a=1 b=2 c=3 d=4 e=5 f=6 g=7 h=8
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $n ]; do
        a=$(( (a * 3 + b) & 0xFFFF ))
        b=$(( (b * 5 + c) & 0xFFFF ))
        c=$(( (c * 7 + d) & 0xFFFF ))
        d=$(( (d * 11 + e) & 0xFFFF ))
        e=$(( (e * 13 + f) & 0xFFFF ))
        f=$(( (f * 17 + g) & 0xFFFF ))
        g=$(( (g * 19 + h) & 0xFFFF ))
        h=$(( (h * 23 + a) & 0xFFFF ))
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo "$a"
}

# 修复 sysfs 文件权限（诊断发现 max_freq 和 governor 是只读的）
fix_sysfs_perms() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    # scaling_max_freq 默认 r--r--r-- (system:system)，需要加写权限
    chmod 664 "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
    # scaling_governor 默认 r--r--r-- (root:root)
    chmod 664 "$base/scaling_governor" 2>/dev/null
    # boost 接口
    chmod 664 "$base/boost" 2>/dev/null
}

lock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    # 关闭 boost
    echo 0 > "$base/boost" 2>/dev/null

    # 策略1：同时写 max 和 min（锁定到精确频率）
    if [ "$MAX_WRITABLE" = "1" ]; then
        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
        sleep 0.5

        local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        local lower=$((freq * 95 / 100))
        local upper=$((freq * 105 / 100))
        if [ "$actual" -ge "$lower" ] && [ "$actual" -le "$upper" ] 2>/dev/null; then
            return 0
        fi
    fi

    # 策略2：只写 min（至少达到目标频率）
    echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    sleep 0.5

    local actual=$(cat "$base/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    # 只用 min 时，频率可能高于目标，接受 >= 目标的 95%
    local lower=$((freq * 95 / 100))
    if [ "$actual" -ge "$lower" ] 2>/dev/null; then
        return 0
    fi

    return 1
}

unlock_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"
    local min_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_min_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$min_avail" > "$base/scaling_min_freq" 2>/dev/null
    echo "$max_avail" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
}

get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

bind_cpus() {
    taskset -p "$1" $$ 2>/dev/null
}

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# 校准测试：确认工作负载是 CPU-bound
# 策略：跑两次不同迭代数，检查时间比例
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准工作负载..."

    # 锁定到中等频率
    lock_freq "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    bind_cpus "$MID_CPUS"
    sleep 1

    # 小批量
    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 100000 > /dev/null
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_small=$((t2 - t1))

    # 大批量
    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 500000 > /dev/null
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_large=$((t4 - t3))

    unlock_freq "$MID_POLICY"

    local ratio=$((ms_large * 100 / ms_small))
    log "  100k迭代: ${ms_small}ms | 500k迭代: ${ms_large}ms | 比例: ${ratio}%"

    # 理想比例应该是 ~500%
    if [ "$ratio" -gt 300 ] && [ "$ratio" -lt 700 ]; then
        log "  ✓ 工作负载可扩展性良好 (${ratio}%)"
    elif [ "$ratio" -gt 200 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 工作负载可扩展性一般 (${ratio}%)"
    else
        log "  ✗ 工作负载可扩展性差 (${ratio}%)，结果可能不准确"
    fi
    log ""

    # 选择合适的迭代数：目标每轮 ~50ms
    local iter_per_ms=$((500000 / (ms_large + 1)))
    local target_iters=$((iter_per_ms * 50))
    # 下取整到万
    target_iters=$((target_iters / 10000 * 10000))
    [ "$target_iters" -lt 10000 ] && target_iters=10000
    [ "$target_iters" -gt 1000000 ] && target_iters=1000000

    log "  推荐每轮迭代数: $target_iters (目标 ~50ms/轮)"
    WORKLOAD_ITERS=$target_iters
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    lock_freq "$policy" "$freq"
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "  跳过: 无法锁定"
        return 1
    fi

    local actual_freq=$(cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  锁定: $((actual_freq/1000))MHz"

    bind_cpus "$cpus"
    sleep 0.5

    # 基线功耗
    log "  采样基线..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s (每轮${WORKLOAD_ITERS}次)..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
    local total_iters=0
    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
        cpu_workload $WORKLOAD_ITERS > /dev/null
        total_iters=$((total_iters + WORKLOAD_ITERS))
    done
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    # 负载功耗
    log "  采样负载..."
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 功耗计算 (避免溢出)
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    # 性能 = 每秒千次迭代
    local iters_per_sec=0
    if [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ]; then
        iters_per_sec=$((total_iters * 1000 / elapsed_ms))
    fi
    local perf_k=$((iters_per_sec / 1000))

    # 能效比 = 每毫瓦的千次迭代/秒
    local efficiency=0
    if [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ]; then
        efficiency=$((perf_k * 100 / power_mw))
    fi

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_k,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 性能=${perf_k}k/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=${efficiency} | 温度 ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"
    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
    return 0
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v3"
    log "=========================================="

    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        exit 1
    fi

    # SELinux 处理
    local selinux_mode=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
    log "SELinux 模式: $selinux_mode"
    if [ "$selinux_mode" = "Enforcing" ]; then
        log "切换 SELinux 到 Permissive 模式..."
        setenforce 0
        local new_mode=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
        log "SELinux 已切换到: $new_mode"
    fi
    log ""

    # 修复 sysfs 权限（诊断发现 max_freq 和 governor 是只读的）
    log "修复 sysfs 文件权限..."
    fix_sysfs_perms "$MID_POLICY"
    fix_sysfs_perms "$BIG_POLICY"

    # 验证写入
    local test_file="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_min_freq"
    local orig_val=$(cat "$test_file" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$orig_val" > "$test_file" 2>/dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "错误: 无法写入 sysfs ($test_file)"
        exit 1
    fi

    # 验证 governor 写入
    local gov_file="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_governor"
    local orig_gov=$(cat "$gov_file" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$orig_gov" > "$gov_file" 2>/dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "警告: 无法写入 governor，将使用当前 governor"
        GOV_WRITABLE=0
    else
        GOV_WRITABLE=1
    fi

    # 验证 max_freq 写入
    local max_file="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_max_freq"
    local orig_max=$(cat "$max_file" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "$orig_max" > "$max_file" 2>/dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        log "警告: 无法写入 max_freq，只能用 min_freq 锁频"
        MAX_WRITABLE=0
    else
        MAX_WRITABLE=1
    fi

    log "权限检查: governor=${GOV_WRITABLE} max_freq=${MAX_WRITABLE} min_freq=1"
    log ""

    if [ ! -f /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now ]; then
        log "错误: 无法读取电流"
        exit 1
    fi

    enable_screen_on
    log "初始温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "LOG: $LOG_FILE"
    log ""

    # 校准
    calibrate

    # CSV 头 (增加实际频率列)
    echo "核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,性能k/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"

    # Governor（需要先 chmod）
    local orig_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    local orig_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
    log "Governor: 中核=$orig_gov_mid 大核=$orig_gov_big"

    if [ "$GOV_WRITABLE" = "1" ]; then
        echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
        echo "performance" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
        local cur_gov_mid=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor)
        local cur_gov_big=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor)
        log "已切换: 中核=$cur_gov_mid 大核=$cur_gov_big"
    else
        log "Governor 不可写，使用当前 governor: $orig_gov_mid / $orig_gov_big"
    fi
    log ""

    # ---- 中核 ----
    log "====== 中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    local mid_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核" && mid_ok=$((mid_ok + 1))
    done
    unlock_freq $MID_POLICY
    log "中核完成: $mid_ok 个"
    log ""

    # ---- 大核 ----
    log "====== 大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    local big_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核" && big_ok=$((big_ok + 1))
    done
    unlock_freq $BIG_POLICY
    log "大核完成: $big_ok 个"
    log ""

    # 恢复 governor
    if [ "$GOV_WRITABLE" = "1" ]; then
        echo "$orig_gov_mid" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor
        echo "$orig_gov_big" > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/scaling_governor
        log "已恢复 Governor"
    fi
    restore_screen

    # 恢复 SELinux
    if [ "$selinux_mode" = "Enforcing" ]; then
        setenforce 1
        log "已恢复 SELinux 为 Enforcing"
    fi

    log "=========================================="
    log "  完成! 温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "  CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
}

main "$@"

OUTPUT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/analysis_${TIMESTAMP}.txt"

log() {
    echo "$1"

}

    log "错误: 找不到结果文件"
    exit 1
fi

log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比分析"

log "=========================================="
log ""

# 格式: 核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,性能k/s,能效比

# 数据质量检查
log "------ 数据质量 ------"

mismatch=$(tail -n +2 "$LATEST" | awk -F',' '$2!=$3' | wc -l)

grep "^中核," "$LATEST" | sort -t',' -k2 -n | while IFS=',' read label target actual elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do

    [ "$target" != "$actual" ] && note="⚠ 实际${actual}"

log "大核组 有效数据排名:"
log ""

grep "^大核," "$LATEST" | awk -F',' '$2==$3 && $8>0' | sort -t',' -k12 -nr | head -3 | while IFS=',' read label target actual elapsed base_i load_i delta_i power base_t load_t perf eff; do

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 权限诊断脚本
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/diagnose.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
OUTPUT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/diagnose_${TIMESTAMP}.txt"

log() {
    echo "$1"
    echo "$1" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
}

log "=============================="
log "  权限诊断"
log "  时间: $(date)"
log "=============================="
log ""

# 1. Root 检查
log "[1] Root 状态"
log "  UID: $(id -u)"
log "  用户: $(id)"
log ""

# 2. SELinux 状态
log "[2] SELinux 状态"
sestatus=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
log "  模式: $sestatus"
if [ "$sestatus" = "Enforcing" ]; then
    log "  ⚠ SELinux 是 Enforcing 模式，会阻止 sysfs 写入"
fi
log ""

# 3. sysfs 写入测试
log "[3] sysfs 写入测试"
test_file="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_min_freq"
log "  测试文件: $test_file"
log "  当前值: $(cat $test_file 2>/dev/null)"

# 尝试写入
echo "1152000" > "$test_file" 2>/tmp/sysfs_err
ret=$?
err=$(cat /tmp/sysfs_err 2>/dev/null)
log "  写入返回值: $ret"
if [ -n "$err" ]; then
    log "  错误信息: $err"
fi

# 检查写入后值是否变化
actual=$(cat "$test_file" 2>/dev/null)
log "  写入后值: $actual"
if [ "$actual" = "1152000" ]; then
    log "  ✓ 写入成功"
else
    log "  ✗ 写入失败"
fi
log ""

# 4. dmesg 权限拒绝日志
log "[4] 最近的 SELinux 拒绝日志"
dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -i "avc.*denied" | tail -5 | while read line; do
    log "  $line"
done
log ""

# 5. 尝试用 sysctl
log "[5] sysctl 测试"
sysctl -a 2>/dev/null | grep -i "sched\|cpufreq" | head -10 | while read line; do
    log "  $line"
done
log ""

# 6. 检查可用的频率控制接口
log "[6] 可用的频率控制接口"
for f in scaling_min_freq scaling_max_freq scaling_governor; do
    path="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/$f"
    perms=$(ls -la "$path" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  $perms"
done
log ""

# 7. 检查 walt governor 特有接口
log "[7] Walt Governor 接口"
for f in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/*; do
    name=$(basename "$f")
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then
        perms=$(ls -la "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1, $3, $4}')
        log "  $name: $perms"
    fi
done
log ""

# 8. 检查 vendor 扩展接口
log "[8] Vendor CPU 控制接口"
for f in /proc/sys/kernel/sched_*; do
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then
        name=$(basename "$f")
        perms=$(ls -la "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
        log "  $name: $perms"
    fi
done 2>/dev/null
log ""

log "=============================="
log "  诊断完成"
log "  结果: $OUTPUT_FILE"
log "=============================="

从 `energy_bench_v3.sh` 可以看到，当前方案最大的麻烦在于**锁频**：

```bash
lock_freq() {
```

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v4
# 核心改进：用 Scene 控制 CPU 最大频率，代替直接写 sysfs
#           负载会自动把频率推到上限，不需要锁频
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/energy_bench_v4.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v4_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v4_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

# ============================================
# Scene 接口配置（运行 probe_scene.sh 确认后修改此处）
# ============================================
# 常见格式示例（根据探测结果选择其一）：
#   格式A: scene set_max_freq 0 1500000
#   格式B: scene cpu --max 0 1500000
#   格式C: content call --method set_max --arg policy0 --arg 1500000
#   格式D: scene频率限制 0 1500000
# ============================================

SCENE_SET_MAX_CMD="scene set_max_freq"       # 设置最大频率的命令前缀
SCENE_GET_MAX_CMD="scene get_max_freq"        # 读取最大频率的命令前缀
SCENE_RESTORE_CMD="scene restore"              # 恢复默认设置的命令

# 频率单位：hz (写入 sysfs 的 kHz) 或 mhz
#   hz: 频率值如 1500000 (1.5GHz = 1500000 kHz)
#   mhz: 频率值如 1500
FREQ_UNIT="hz"

# ============================================
# CPU 配置
# ============================================
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

BENCH_DURATION=10          # 每轮测试秒数
COOL_DOWN=5                # 轮间冷却秒数

# ============================================
# 屏幕控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    if [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo $((0 - raw))
    else
        echo "$raw"
    fi
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    # 优先读 CPU 温度
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    local sec=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f1)
    local frac=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f2 | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

get_cur_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null || echo "0"
}

# ============================================
# Scene 接口封装
# ============================================

scene_set_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    # policy 映射: policy0 → 0, policy6 → 6
    local policy_num=$(echo "$policy" | sed 's/policy//')
    log "  Scene: $SCENE_SET_MAX_CMD $policy_num $freq"
    $SCENE_SET_MAX_CMD "$policy_num" "$freq" 2>&1
}

scene_restore() {
    log "  Scene: $SCENE_RESTORE_CMD"
    $SCENE_RESTORE_CMD 2>&1
}

# ============================================
# CPU-bound 工作负载（与 v3 相同）
# 纯寄存器运算，最小化内存瓶颈
# ============================================

cpu_workload() {
    local n=$1
    local a=1 b=2 c=3 d=4 e=5 f=6 g=7 h=8
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $n ]; do
        a=$(( (a * 3 + b) & 0xFFFF ))
        b=$(( (b * 5 + c) & 0xFFFF ))
        c=$(( (c * 7 + d) & 0xFFFF ))
        d=$(( (d * 11 + e) & 0xFFFF ))
        e=$(( (e * 13 + f) & 0xFFFF ))
        f=$(( (f * 17 + g) & 0xFFFF ))
        g=$(( (g * 19 + h) & 0xFFFF ))
        h=$(( (h * 23 + a) & 0xFFFF ))
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo "$a"
}

# ============================================
# 采样函数
# ============================================

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# 校准（与 v3 相同）
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准工作负载..."
    # 先用 Scene 设到中频验证
    scene_set_max "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    sleep 1

    # 验证频率确实上去了
    local verify_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$MID_POLICY")
    log "  当前频率: $((verify_freq/1000))MHz"

    # 小批量
    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 100000 > /dev/null
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_small=$((t2 - t1))

    # 大批量
    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 500000 > /dev/null
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_large=$((t4 - t3))

    local ratio=$((ms_large * 100 / ms_small))
    log "  100k: ${ms_small}ms | 500k: ${ms_large}ms | 比例: ${ratio}%"

    if [ "$ratio" -gt 300 ] && [ "$ratio" -lt 700 ]; then
        log "  ✓ 工作负载可扩展性良好"
    elif [ "$ratio" -gt 200 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 可扩展性一般"
    else
        log "  ✗ 可扩展性差，结果可能不准确"
    fi

    # 选迭代数：目标每轮 ~50ms
    local iter_per_ms=$((500000 / (ms_large + 1)))
    local target_iters=$((iter_per_ms * 50 / 10000 * 10000))
    [ "$target_iters" -lt 10000 ] && target_iters=10000
    [ "$target_iters" -gt 1000000 ] && target_iters=1000000
    log "  每轮迭代: $target_iters (目标 ~50ms/轮)"
    log ""
    WORKLOAD_ITERS=$target_iters
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    # === 关键变化：用 Scene 设置最大频率 ===
    scene_set_max "$policy" "$freq"
    sleep 1

    # 验证
    local actual_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$policy")
    log "  实际频率: $((actual_freq/1000))MHz (目标 ${freq_mhz}MHz)"

    # 绑定 CPU
    taskset -p "$cpus" $$ 2>/dev/null

    # 基线功耗
    log "  采样基线..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 运行负载（CPU 自动推到上限）
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
    local total_iters=0
    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
        cpu_workload $WORKLOAD_ITERS > /dev/null
        total_iters=$((total_iters + WORKLOAD_ITERS))
    done
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    # 负载功耗
    log "  采样负载..."
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v4
# 核心改进：用 Scene 控制 CPU 最大频率，代替直接写 sysfs
#           负载会自动把频率推到上限，不需要锁频
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/energy_bench_v4.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v4_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v4_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

# ============================================
# Scene 接口配置（运行 probe_scene.sh 确认后修改此处）
# ============================================
# 常见格式示例（根据探测结果选择其一）：
#   格式A: scene set_max_freq 0 1500000
#   格式B: scene cpu --max 0 1500000
#   格式C: content call --method set_max --arg policy0 --arg 1500000
#   格式D: scene频率限制 0 1500000
# ============================================

SCENE_SET_MAX_CMD="scene set_max_freq"       # 设置最大频率的命令前缀
SCENE_GET_MAX_CMD="scene get_max_freq"        # 读取最大频率的命令前缀
SCENE_RESTORE_CMD="scene restore"              # 恢复默认设置的命令

# 频率单位：hz (写入 sysfs 的 kHz) 或 mhz
#   hz: 频率值如 1500000 (1.5GHz = 1500000 kHz)
#   mhz: 频率值如 1500
FREQ_UNIT="hz"

# ============================================
# CPU 配置
# ============================================
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

BENCH_DURATION=10          # 每轮测试秒数
COOL_DOWN=5                # 轮间冷却秒数

# ============================================
# 屏幕控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    if [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo $((0 - raw))
    else
        echo "$raw"
    fi
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    # 优先读 CPU 温度
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local temp_raw=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            if [ -n "$temp_raw" ] && [ "$temp_raw" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
                echo $((temp_raw / 1000))
                return
            fi
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    local sec=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f1)
    local frac=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f2 | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

get_cur_freq() {
    local policy=$1
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null || echo "0"
}

# ============================================
# Scene 接口封装
# ============================================

scene_set_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    # policy 映射: policy0 → 0, policy6 → 6
    local policy_num=$(echo "$policy" | sed 's/policy//')
    log "  Scene: $SCENE_SET_MAX_CMD $policy_num $freq"
    $SCENE_SET_MAX_CMD "$policy_num" "$freq" 2>&1
}

scene_restore() {
    log "  Scene: $SCENE_RESTORE_CMD"
    $SCENE_RESTORE_CMD 2>&1
}

# ============================================
# CPU-bound 工作负载（与 v3 相同）
# 纯寄存器运算，最小化内存瓶颈
# ============================================

cpu_workload() {
    local n=$1
    local a=1 b=2 c=3 d=4 e=5 f=6 g=7 h=8
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $n ]; do
        a=$(( (a * 3 + b) & 0xFFFF ))
        b=$(( (b * 5 + c) & 0xFFFF ))
        c=$(( (c * 7 + d) & 0xFFFF ))
        d=$(( (d * 11 + e) & 0xFFFF ))
        e=$(( (e * 13 + f) & 0xFFFF ))
        f=$(( (f * 17 + g) & 0xFFFF ))
        g=$(( (g * 19 + h) & 0xFFFF ))
        h=$(( (h * 23 + a) & 0xFFFF ))
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo "$a"
}

# ============================================
# 采样函数
# ============================================

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        local c=$(read_current)
        sum=$((sum + c))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# 校准（与 v3 相同）
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准工作负载..."
    # 先用 Scene 设到中频验证
    scene_set_max "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    sleep 1

    # 验证频率确实上去了

    log "  当前频率: $((verify_freq/1000))MHz"

    # 小批量

    cpu_workload 100000 > /dev/null
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_small=$((t2 - t1))

    # 大批量
    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 500000 > /dev/null
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_large=$((t4 - t3))

    local ratio=$((ms_large * 100 / ms_small))
    log "  100k: ${ms_small}ms | 500k: ${ms_large}ms | 比例: ${ratio}%"

    if [ "$ratio" -gt 300 ] && [ "$ratio" -lt 700 ]; then
        log "  ✓ 工作负载可扩展性良好"
    elif [ "$ratio" -gt 200 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 可扩展性一般"
    else
        log "  ✗ 可扩展性差，结果可能不准确"
    fi

    # 选迭代数：目标每轮 ~50ms
    local iter_per_ms=$((500000 / (ms_large + 1)))
    local target_iters=$((iter_per_ms * 50 / 10000 * 10000))
    [ "$target_iters" -lt 10000 ] && target_iters=10000
    [ "$target_iters" -gt 1000000 ] && target_iters=1000000
    log "  每轮迭代: $target_iters (目标 ~50ms/轮)"

    local policy=$1

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
OUTPUT="$SCRIPT_DIR/scene_probe_result.txt"

    echo "$1" >> "$OUTPUT"
}

log "  时间: $(date)"

log "[1] Scene 安装确认"
PKG_PATH=$(pm path "$PKG" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/package://')
if [ -n "$PKG_PATH" ]; then
    log "  ✓ 已安装: $PKG_PATH"
else
    log "  ✗ $PKG 未安装"
fi
log ""

# 2. ContentProvider 探测（Scene 的主要接口方式）
log "[2] ContentProvider: $AUTHORITY"
log ""

# 2a. 直接 query

content query --uri "content://$AUTHORITY" 2>&1 | while read line; do
    log "    $line"
done
log ""

# 2b. 尝试读取 CPU 相关路径
for path in \
    "cpu" \
    "cpu/freq" \
    "cpu/max_freq" \
    "cpu/settings" \
    "freq" \
    "settings/cpu" \
    "performance" \
    "status"; do
    result=$(content query --uri "content://$AUTHORITY/$path" 2>&1)
    if echo "$result" | grep -qv "Unknown\|No such\|not found\|Error"; then
        log "  ✓ content://$AUTHORITY/$path"
        log "    $result"
    else
        log "  ✗ content://$AUTHORITY/$path"
    fi
done
log ""

# 2c. 尝试 call 方法
log "  [2b] content call 探测"
for method in \
    "get_max_freq" \
    "set_max_freq" \
    "get_cpu_freq" \
    "set_cpu_freq" \
    "get_freq" \
    "set_freq" \
    "cpu_max" \
    "cpu_settings" \
    "read" \
    "query"; do
    result=$(content call --uri "content://$AUTHORITY" --method "$method" 2>&1)
    if echo "$result" | grep -qv "Unknown\|No such\|not found\|Error\|null"; then
        log "  ✓ method=$method"
        log "    $result"
    fi
done
log ""

    log "  路径: $scene_path"
else

    for p in /data/local/tmp/scene /data/adb/modules/scene /sdcard/scene /data/data/$PKG/scene; do

            log "  找到: $p"
            scene_path="$p"
        fi
    done
fi
log ""

if [ -n "$scene_path" ]; then
    log "  执行 scene (无参数):"
    "$scene_path" 2>&1 | head -30 | while read line; do
        log "    $line"
    done
    log ""
    log "  执行 scene --help:"
    "$scene_path" --help 2>&1 | head -30 | while read line; do
        log "    $line"
    done
    log ""
    log "  执行 scene help:"
    "$scene_path" help 2>&1 | head -30 | while read line; do
        log "    $line"
    done
fi
log ""

# 4. app_process 方式（Scene 可能通过 app_process 启动 Java 服务）
log "[4] app_process / dex 方式"
# 检查 Scene 的 dex/jar 文件
for path in /data/local/tmp /data/adb/modules/*/scene /sdcard/scene; do
    ls "$path"/*.dex "$path"/*.jar "$path"/*.sh 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
        log "  找到: $f"
        if echo "$f" | grep -q "\.sh$"; then
            log "    内容预览:"
            head -10 "$f" 2>/dev/null | while read line; do
                log "      $line"
            done
        fi
    done

log ""

DATA_DIR="/data/data/$PKG"
if [ -d "$DATA_DIR" ]; then

        log "  prefs: $f"
    done
    # 检查 files 目录下的脚本

        log "  file: $f"
    done
else

fi
log ""

# 6. busybox / toolbox 里的 scene 别名

for d in /system/bin /system/xbin /data/local/bin /sbin; do

    max_freq=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)
    cur_freq=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null)
    min_freq=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_min_freq 2>/dev/null)
    governor=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null)
    log "  $policy: gov=$governor min=$min_freq cur=$cur_freq max=$max_freq"
done
log ""

# 8. Scene 后台进程
log "[8] Scene 相关进程"
ps -A 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "scene|omarea|vtools" | while read line; do
    log "  $line"

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# Scene CLI 接口探测脚本
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/probe_scene.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
OUTPUT="$SCRIPT_DIR/scene_probe_result.txt"

log() {
    echo "$1"
    echo "$1" >> "$OUTPUT"
}

log "=========================================="
log "  Scene CLI 接口探测"
log "  时间: $(date)"
log "=========================================="
log ""

# 1. 检查 Scene 是否安装
log "[1] Scene 安装检测"
PKG=$(pm list packages 2>/dev/null | grep -i scene)
if [ -n "$PKG" ]; then
    log "  Scene 已安装: $PKG"
    SCENE_PKG=$(echo "$PKG" | sed 's/package://')
else
    log "  ✗ Scene 未找到"
fi
log ""

# 2. 检查 scene 命令行工具
log "[2] scene 命令检测"
for cmd in scene; do
    path=$(which "$cmd" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$path" ]; then
        log "  scene 命令路径: $path"
        "$cmd" --help 2>&1 | head -20 | while read line; do
            log "    $line"
        done
    else
        log "  尝试直接执行 scene..."
        scene 2>&1 | head -20 | while read line; do
            log "    $line"
        done
    fi
done
log ""

# 3. 检测 Scene 的 ContentProvider
log "[3] Scene ContentProvider 检测"
# Scene 常见的 provider authority
for authority in \
    "com.omarea.vtools.provider" \
    "com.omarea.vtools.scene" \
    "com.hellobbn.scene.provider"; do
    result=$(content query --uri "content://$authority" 2>&1)
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        log "  找到: $authority"
        log "  $result"
    fi
done
log ""

# 4. 列出 Scene 包的文件结构
log "[4] Scene 安装路径"
if [ -n "$SCENE_PKG" ]; then
    pkg_path=$(pm path "$SCENE_PKG" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/package://')
    log "  APK 路径: $pkg_path"
    # 查找 scene 可能在的 bin 目录
    for path in /data/local/tmp/scene /data/adb/modules/*/scene /sdcard/scene; do
        if [ -f "$path" ] || [ -d "$path" ]; then
            log "  找到: $path"
            ls -la "$path" 2>/dev/null | while read line; do
                log "    $line"
            done
        fi
    done
fi
log ""

# 5. 测试：尝试 Scene 常见命令格式读当前值
log "[5] 尝试读取当前 CPU 频率上限"
# Scene 可能的读命令格式
for cmd in \
    "scene get_max_freq" \
    "scene get_max_freq 0" \
    "scene get_max_freq 6" \
    "scene cpu_max 0" \
    "scene cpu_max 6" \
    "scene status"; do
    result=$($cmd 2>&1)
    if [ -n "$result" ] && echo "$result" | grep -qv "not found\|No such\|error\|unknown\|invalid"; then
        log "  ✓ $cmd"
        log "    $result"
    else
        log "  ✗ $cmd (无响应或报错)"
    fi
done
log ""

# 6. 检查 sysfs 当前状态（对照组）
log "[6] 当前 sysfs 状态"
for policy in policy0 policy6; do
    max_freq=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)
    cur_freq=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null)
    min_freq=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_min_freq 2>/dev/null)
    governor=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null)
    log "  $policy: governor=$governor min=$min_freq cur=$cur_freq max=$max_freq"
done
log ""

# 7. 检查 Scene 相关进程
log "[7] Scene 相关进程"
ps -A 2>/dev/null | grep -i scene | while read line; do
    log "  $line"
done
log ""

log "=========================================="
log "  探测完成"
log "  结果保存到: $OUTPUT"
log "=========================================="

content.thinking:
关键发现：

1. **ContentProvider 不可用**：第2节的所有 provider 调用全部失败 `Could not find provider: com.omarea.vtools.provider`。这说明 Scene 的 provider 没有以传统方式暴露，或者需要授权。

2. **没有 scene CLI 命令**：第3节找不到任何 `scene` 命令行工具。

3. **关键发现：scene-daemon**！第8节显示有一个 `scene-daemon` 进程以 root 运行（`root 26663`）。而且第5节在 `/data/data/com.omarea.vtools/files/` 下找到了：
   - `scene-daemon` — 主守护进程
   - `scene-daemon-bak` — 备份
   - `daemon-stdin` / `daemon-stdout` — 守护进程的输入输出！
   - `daemon.log` / `daemon.stderr.log` — 日志
   - `binder.so` / `binder12-15.so` — Binder IPC 库
   - `rish.sh` / `rish_shizuku.dex` — Shizuku 集成
   - `kr-script/executor.sh` — KR 脚本执行器
   - `powercfg.sh` — 电源配置文件
   - `busybox` — busybox 工具

4. **Sysfs 当前状态**：
   - policy0 (中核): walt governor, min=384MHz, cur=2400MHz, max=3532800
   - policy6 (大核): walt governor, min=1017600, cur=1017600, max=4320000

5. **daemon-stdin/daemon-stdout** 是关键！Scene 的 daemon 接受 stdin 输入命令 → stdout 返回结果。这是它的 IPC 方式。

6. **Scene 配置目录**：
   - `powercfg.xml` — 电源配置
   - `kr-script-config.xml` — KR 脚本配置

  chmod 0664 "$path"
  echo "$value" > "$path"
  fi;
  fi;

# 配置区
# ============================================
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

BENCH_DURATION=10
COOL_DOWN=5

# ============================================
# Scene 风格的 sysfs 写入函数
# 核心技巧：
#   lock_value: chmod → write → chmod (绕过写保护)
#   hide_value: mount --bind 劫持 (绕过内核级保护，如 msm_performance)
# ============================================

lock_value() {
    local value=$1
    local path=$2
    if [ -f "$path" ]; then
        chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
        echo "$value" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 444 "$path" 2>/dev/null
    fi
}

set_value() {
    local value=$1
    local path=$2
    if [ -f "$path" ]; then
        local current=$(cat "$path" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$current" != "$value" ]; then
            chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
            echo "$value" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        fi
    fi
}

# mount bind 劫持 —— 用于 msm_performance 这种被内核保护的参数
hide_value() {
    local path=$1
    local value=$2
    if [ -e "$path" ]; then
        umount "$path" 2>/dev/null
        local tmp="/data/local/tmp/scene_$(echo "$path" | tr '/' '_')"
        if [ ! -f "$tmp" ]; then
            cp -f "$path" "$tmp" 2>/dev/null
        fi
        set_value "$value" "$path"
        mount --bind "$tmp" "$path" 2>/dev/null
    fi
}

# ============================================
# 频率控制核心（v4 关键变化：只设上限）
# ============================================

set_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    # 1. 禁用 walt 自适应频率（关键！否则 walt 会忽略我们的上限）
    local walt_dir="$base/walt"
    if [ -d "$walt_dir" ]; then
        lock_value 0 "$walt_dir/adaptive_high_freq"
        lock_value 0 "$walt_dir/adaptive_low_freq"
    fi

    # 2. 写 scaling_max_freq（主要限制点）
    lock_value "$freq" "$base/scaling_max_freq"

    # 3. 写 msm_performance（如果存在）
    # 格式: 0:freq 1:freq 2:freq ...（per-CPU）
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        local policy_num=$(echo "$policy" | sed 's/policy//')
        # 构建 per-cpu 频率字符串
        case "$policy_num" in
            0) local cpus="0 1 2 3 4 5" ;;
            6) local cpus="6 7" ;;
            *) local cpus="$policy_num" ;;
        esac
        local msm_str=""
        for cpu in $cpus; do
            msm_str="$msm_str $cpu:$freq"
        done
        # 读当前值，只修改对应 CPU
        local current_msm=$(cat "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null)
        [ -n "$current_msm" ] && set_value "$(echo "$current_msm" | sed -E "s/[0-9]+:[0-9]+/$cpus_str/g")" "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 4. 绕过温控限制（thermal_message/cpu_limits）
    local t_msg="/sys/class/thermal/thermal_message"
    if [ -f "$t_msg/cpu_limits" ]; then
        chmod 644 "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
        local max_freq_all=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        for cpu in $cpus; do
            echo "cpu$cpu $max_freq_all" > "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
        done
        chmod 444 "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
    fi
}

restore_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    # 恢复 walt 自适应
    if [ -d "$base/walt" ]; then
        lock_value 1 "$base/walt/adaptive_high_freq"
        lock_value 1 "$base/walt/adaptive_low_freq"
    fi

    # 恢复 max_freq
    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    lock_value "$max_avail" "$base/scaling_max_freq"

    # 恢复 msm_performance
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        set_value "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 2:4294967295 3:4294967295 4:4294967295 5:4294967295 6:4294967295 7:4294967295" "$msm_max"
    fi
}

# ============================================
# 屏幕控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && raw=$((0 - raw))
    echo "$raw"
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local t=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            [ -n "$t" ] && [ "$t" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null && echo $((t / 1000)) && return
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    local sec=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f1)
    local frac=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f2 | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

get_cur_freq() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null || echo "0"
}

get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

# ============================================
# CPU-bound 工作负载
# ============================================

cpu_workload() {
    local n=$1
    local a=1 b=2 c=3 d=4 e=5 f=6 g=7 h=8
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $n ]; do
        a=$(( (a * 3 + b) & 0xFFFF ))
        b=$(( (b * 5 + c) & 0xFFFF ))
        c=$(( (c * 7 + d) & 0xFFFF ))
        d=$(( (d * 11 + e) & 0xFFFF ))
        e=$(( (e * 13 + f) & 0xFFFF ))
        f=$(( (f * 17 + g) & 0xFFFF ))
        g=$(( (g * 19 + h) & 0xFFFF ))
        h=$(( (h * 23 + a) & 0xFFFF ))
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo "$a"
}

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        sum=$((sum + $(read_current)))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# 校准
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准工作负载..."
    set_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    sleep 1

    log "  当前频率: $(( $(get_cur_freq $MID_POLICY) / 1000 ))MHz"

    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 100000 > /dev/null
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_small=$((t2 - t1))

    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 500000 > /dev/null
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_large=$((t4 - t3))

    local ratio=$((ms_large * 100 / ms_small))
    log "  100k: ${ms_small}ms | 500k: ${ms_large}ms | 比例: ${ratio}%"

    if [ "$ratio" -gt 300 ] && [ "$ratio" -lt 700 ]; then
        log "  ✓ 可扩展性良好"
    elif [ "$ratio" -gt 200 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 可扩展性一般"
    else
        log "  ✗ 可扩展性差"
    fi

    local iter_per_ms=$((500000 / (ms_large + 1)))
    local target_iters=$((iter_per_ms * 50 / 10000 * 10000))
    [ "$target_iters" -lt 10000 ] && target_iters=10000
    [ "$target_iters" -gt 1000000 ] && target_iters=1000000
    log "  每轮迭代: $target_iters"
    log ""
    WORKLOAD_ITERS=$target_iters

    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试（v4 核心：只设上限，不锁频率）
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    # === v4 核心：只设置 max_freq ===
    set_cpu_max "$policy" "$freq"
    sleep 1

    # 绑定 CPU 核
    taskset -p "$cpus" $$ 2>/dev/null

    # 先跑一轮预热让频率上去
    cpu_workload $((WORKLOAD_ITERS)) > /dev/null
    sleep 0.5

    # 验证实际频率
    local actual_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$policy")
    local actual_mhz=$((actual_freq / 1000))
    log "  目标=${freq_mhz}MHz 实际=${actual_mhz}MHz"

    # 基线
    log "  采样基线..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 负载（CPU 自动跑在 max_freq）
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
    local total_iters=0
    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
        cpu_workload $WORKLOAD_ITERS > /dev/null
        total_iters=$((total_iters + WORKLOAD_ITERS))
    done
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    # 负载采样
    log "  采样负载..."
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    local iters_per_sec=0
    [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ] && iters_per_sec=$((total_iters * 1000 / elapsed_ms))
    local perf_k=$((iters_per_sec / 1000))

    local efficiency=0
    [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ] && efficiency=$((perf_k * 100 / power_mw))

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_k,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 性能=${perf_k}k/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=${efficiency} | ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"
    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v4"
    log "  策略: 限制 max_freq + 负载自动推满"
    log "=========================================="

    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        exit 1
    fi

    # SELinux
    local selinux_orig=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ]; then
        setenforce 0
        log "SELinux: Enforcing → Permissive"
    fi

    # 备份 + 解锁 msm_performance（如果有 chattr +i 锁定）
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 屏幕常亮 + 最低亮度
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null

    log "当前 governor: $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null)"
    log "中核范围: $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/cpuinfo_min_freq)-$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/cpuinfo_max_freq)"
    log "大核范围: $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/cpuinfo_min_freq)-$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/cpuinfo_max_freq)"
    log "初始温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log ""

    # 校准
    calibrate

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,性能k/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"
    log "CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 中核组
    # ============================================
    log "====== 中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    local mid_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核" && mid_ok=$((mid_ok + 1))
    done
    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
    log "中核完成: $mid_ok 个"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 大核组
    # ============================================
    log "====== 大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    local big_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核" && big_ok=$((big_ok + 1))
    done
    restore_cpu_max "$BIG_POLICY"
    log "大核完成: $big_ok 个"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 恢复
    # ============================================
    [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ] && settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ] && settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ] && setenforce 1

    log "=========================================="
    log "  完成! 温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "  中核: $mid_ok | 大核: $big_ok"
    log "  CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
}

main "$@"

    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        sum=$((sum + $(read_current)))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# 校准
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准工作负载..."
    set_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    sleep 1

    log "  当前频率: $(( $(get_cur_freq $MID_POLICY) / 1000 ))MHz"

    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 100000 > /dev/null
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_small=$((t2 - t1))

    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    cpu_workload 500000 > /dev/null
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ms_large=$((t4 - t3))

    local ratio=$((ms_large * 100 / ms_small))
    log "  100k: ${ms_small}ms | 500k: ${ms_large}ms | 比例: ${ratio}%"

    if [ "$ratio" -gt 300 ] && [ "$ratio" -lt 700 ]; then
        log "  ✓ 可扩展性良好"
    elif [ "$ratio" -gt 200 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 可扩展性一般"
    else
        log "  ✗ 可扩展性差"
    fi

    local iter_per_ms=$((500000 / (ms_large + 1)))
    local target_iters=$((iter_per_ms * 50 / 10000 * 10000))
    [ "$target_iters" -lt 10000 ] && target_iters=10000
    [ "$target_iters" -gt 1000000 ] && target_iters=1000000
    log "  每轮迭代: $target_iters"
    log ""
    WORKLOAD_ITERS=$target_iters

    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试（v4 核心：只设上限，不锁频率）
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz"

    # === v4 核心：只设置 max_freq ===
    set_cpu_max "$policy" "$freq"
    sleep 1

    # 绑定 CPU 核
    taskset -p "$cpus" $$ 2>/dev/null

    # 先跑一轮预热让频率上去
    cpu_workload $((WORKLOAD_ITERS)) > /dev/null
    sleep 0.5

    # 验证实际频率
    local actual_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$policy")
    local actual_mhz=$((actual_freq / 1000))
    log "  目标=${freq_mhz}MHz 实际=${actual_mhz}MHz"

    # 基线
    log "  采样基线..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 负载（CPU 自动跑在 max_freq）
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
    local total_iters=0
    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
        cpu_workload $WORKLOAD_ITERS > /dev/null
        total_iters=$((total_iters + WORKLOAD_ITERS))
    done
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    # 负载采样
    log "  采样负载..."
    local load_current=$(sample_current 3)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    local iters_per_sec=0
    [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ] && iters_per_sec=$((total_iters * 1000 / elapsed_ms))
    local perf_k=$((iters_per_sec / 1000))

    local efficiency=0
    [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ] && efficiency=$((perf_k * 100 / power_mw))

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$perf_k,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 性能=${perf_k}k/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=${efficiency} | ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"
    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v4"
    log "  策略: 限制 max_freq + 负载自动推满"
    log "=========================================="

    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        exit 1
    fi

    # SELinux
    local selinux_orig=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ]; then
        setenforce 0
        log "SELinux: Enforcing → Permissive"
    fi

    # 备份 + 解锁 msm_performance（如果有 chattr +i 锁定）
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 屏幕常亮 + 最低亮度
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null

    log "当前 governor: $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null)"
    log "中核范围: $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/cpuinfo_min_freq)-$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/cpuinfo_max_freq)"
    log "大核范围: $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/cpuinfo_min_freq)-$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$BIG_POLICY/cpuinfo_max_freq)"
    log "初始温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log ""

    # 校准
    calibrate

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,性能k/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"
    log "CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 中核组
    # ============================================
    log "====== 中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) ======"
    local mid_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核" && mid_ok=$((mid_ok + 1))
    done
    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
    log "中核完成: $mid_ok 个"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 大核组
    # ============================================
    log "====== 大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) ======"
    local big_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核" && big_ok=$((big_ok + 1))
    done
    restore_cpu_max "$BIG_POLICY"
    log "大核完成: $big_ok 个"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 恢复
    # ============================================
    [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ] && settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ] && settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ] && setenforce 1

    log "=========================================="
    log "  完成! 温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "  中核: $mid_ok | 大核: $big_ok"
    log "  CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
}

main "$@"

## v4 vs v3：一句话总结

**v3** 的思路是「锁死频率」：同时设 min 和 max 为目标值，切 performance governor。相当于把 frequency scaling 整个关掉，跟 kernel 抢控制权。

**v4** 的思路是「只设上限」：设 max 为目标值，保留 walt governor。CPU 负载一来，walt 自然推高频率到上限。从 `powercfg.sh` 拿到了三个关键技巧：

```
lock_value   → chmod 644 → write → chmod 444（绕过写保护）
hide_value   → mount --bind 劫持（绕过 msm_performance 的内核锁）
walt 自适应  → 设为 0，防止 walt 覆盖你的 max_freq
```

| | v3 | v4 |
|---|---|---|
| 频率控制 | 锁 min+max+governor | 只设 max |
| Governor | 切到 performance | 保留 walt |
| sysfs 技巧 | `chmod 664` | `lock_value` + `hide_value` |
| walt 自适应 | 未处理 | 显式禁用 |
| msm_performance | 未处理 | `chattr -i` 解锁 |
| 温控绕过 | 未处理 | `thermal_message/cpu_limits` |
| 代码行数 | ~460 | ~320 |

连上手机后推过去跑：

```bash
adb push 能耗比测试\energy_bench_v4.sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/
adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/energy_bench_v4.sh'
```

## Problem 1: 大核 (Big cores) - max_freq not taking effect

Looking at the big core data:

- Even when target is 4320MHz, the actual frequency stays at 1017MHz

This means `set_cpu_max()` is NOT working for the big cores at all. The frequency is stuck at the minimum.

## Problem 2: 中核 (Middle cores) - partial failures

Several mid-core test points also failed to reach target:
- 556MHz target → actual 384MHz

- 3532MHz target → actual 2400MHz

But several mid-core points SUCCEEDED: 960, 1363, 1555, 1785, 1996, 2227, 2400, 2745, 2918, 3321MHz all hit their targets.

So `set_cpu_max()` partially works for mid cores, but not at all for big cores.

## Problem 3: Performance doesn't scale with frequency

For mid cores, performance is flat:
- 384MHz → 66k/s
- 960MHz → 50k/s  
- 1363MHz → 57k/s
- 1785MHz → 59k/s
- 2400MHz → 60k/s
- 3321MHz → 61k/s
- 3532MHz → 61k/s

This is essentially FLAT despite frequency more than doubling. This means the workload is NOT CPU-bound - it's likely memory bound (cache/memory latency dominates).

Actually wait - the workload is shell arithmetic in a `while` loop. Shell arithmetic is incredibly slow and the overhead of process forking, shell interpretation etc. might mean the actual work being done per iteration is minimal. The shell's own overhead dominates.

## Problem 4: Power consumption is weirdly inconsistent

Mid core 3321MHz: power=1503mW (the highest frequency but lowest power??)
Mid core 3532MHz: power=4389mW

These outliers suggest the current sampling is unreliable. Baseline current varies wildly:
- 384MHz baseline: 292,000 uA
- 556MHz baseline: 855,333 uA
- 3321MHz baseline: 928,000 uA

The baseline shouldn't vary that much at idle. Something is contaminating the measurements.

## Root Cause Analysis

### 大核 stuck at 1017MHz
The most likely cause: `msm_performance` module or thermal throttling is overriding our `scaling_max_freq` setting. Or the walt governor's `adaptive_low_freq` setting is different for big cores.

Also note: the big cores' `cpuinfo_min_freq` = 1017600, and `scaling_cur_freq` in the probe was also 1017600. This is likely because:
1. Big core idle behavior is different
2. The `core_ctl` (core control) might be keeping big cores at min frequency
3. There might be a separate thermal limit for big cores

Looking at `powercfg.sh` again:
```bash
echo 80 80 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu6/core_ctl/busy_up_thres
echo 55 55 > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu6/core_ctl/busy_down_thres
```

The big cores have `core_ctl` which manages hotplugging. The threshold might be too high, preventing the big cores from ramping up.

Actually, the bigger issue might be that `set_cpu_max` only sets `scaling_max_freq`, but for the big cores, something else is overriding. The walt governor may have different behavior for different clusters.

For the big cores, since `cpuinfo_min_freq` = 1017600 and we're seeing exactly that value, it suggests the governor is keeping the cores at minimum regardless of load. This could be because:
1. The workload is pinned to all CPUs `cpu6-7` but `core_ctl` keeps cpu7 offline
2. The thermal limits prevent big core from ramping up
3. The walt governor has cluster-specific adaptive settings

### Performance not scaling
This is a fundamental problem with the shell-based CPU workload. Shell arithmetic (`$((...))`) is:
- Interpreted (not compiled)
- Extremely slow per operation
- The `while` loop overhead dominates actual computation

Even though the workload does 8 arithmetic ops per iteration, each iteration in shell takes microseconds, so at 10k iterations per round the computational density is very low.

The calibration showed that 500k iterations took 6780ms at 1785MHz. That's about 73.7k iterations/second at maximum frequency. But at 384MHz we got 66k/s. The 5x frequency change only gives a ~10% performance change. This confirms the workload is bottlenecked by something other than CPU frequency - likely shell interpretation overhead and memory latency.

2. **Workload** - shell arithmetic is too slow and not CPU-bound enough. Need a real binary workload

## Workload fix with busybox

Busybox provides several tools that can create CPU load:
- `dd if=/dev/zero bs=... count=...` — memory/CPU throughput test
- `md5sum` / `sha256sum` — compute hashes (pure CPU)
- `yes | head` or piping data through `md5sum`
- `timeout N dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=10000 | md5sum` — CPU-bound

Actually, the best CPU-bound busybox workload would be:
```bash
dd if=/dev/zero bs=64k count=10000 2>/dev/null | $BUSYBOX md5sum
```
But this involves I/O through pipes.

Better: compute hashes on a static dataset repeatedly:
```bash
$BUSYBOX time $BUSYBOX md5sum /dev/zero
```

Or even better, generate data with dd and pipe through sha256sum in a loop. 

Actually the simplest CPU-bound test with busybox:
```bash
# Generate a fixed block of data in memory and hash it repeatedly
dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=10 2>/dev/null | $BUSYBOX sha256sum
```

But we want sustained CPU load for 10 seconds. Something like:
```bash
end_time=$(( $(date +%s) + 10 ))
while [ $(date +%s) -lt $end_time ]; do
    dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=10 2>/dev/null | $BUSYBOX sha256sum > /dev/null
done
```

Actually, `dd if=/dev/zero bs=... | sha256sum` is NOT purely CPU-bound because `/dev/zero` involves kernel I/O (though very minor). 

A purer CPU workload with busybox:
```bash
# Create a test file in RAM (tmpfs)
dd if=/dev/urandom of=/dev/shm/testfile bs=1M count=5 2>/dev/null
# Repeatedly hash it
while [...]; do
    $BUSYBOX sha256sum /dev/shm/testfile > /dev/null
done
```

Or even simpler - using `$BUSYBOX md5sum` on a fixed string:
```bash
# Generate some data once
DATA=$(dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=4 2>/dev/null | $BUSYBOX base64)
# Repeatedly hash
while [...]; do
    echo "$DATA" | $BUSYBOX sha256sum > /dev/null
done
```

Wait, the issue is that pipe operations involve process spawning which has overhead. Better to write to a tmpfs file once.
