#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v5
# 改进：
#   1. busybox sha256sum 做真正 CPU-bound 负载（替代 shell 算术）
#   2. 大核诊断：每个测试点前后 dump sysfs，定位频率不生效原因
#   3. 采样增加 + settle 期，减少基线波动
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/energy_bench_v5.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v5_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v5_${TIMESTAMP}.log"
DIAG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v5_${TIMESTAMP}_diag.csv"

# ============================================
# 路径配置
# ============================================
BUSYBOX="/data/data/com.omarea.vtools/files/busybox"
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

BENCH_DURATION=10
COOL_DOWN=5
CURRENT_SAMPLES=5       # 从 3 增加到 5
SETTLE_SEC=2            # 频率切换后的稳定期

# ============================================
# sysfs 写入函数（复用 Scene 的 lock_value 技巧）
# ============================================

lock_value() {
    local value=$1
    local path=$2
    if [ -f "$path" ]; then
        chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
        echo "$value" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 444 "$path" 2>/dev/null
    fi
}

set_value() {
    local value=$1
    local path=$2
    if [ -f "$path" ]; then
        local current=$(cat "$path" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$current" != "$value" ]; then
            chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
            echo "$value" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        fi
    fi
}

# ============================================
# 诊断：dump 一个 policy 的所有相关 sysfs（定位大核问题）
# ============================================

diag_dump_policy() {
    local policy=$1
    local tag=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    (
    echo "$tag,$policy,scaling_governor,$(cat $base/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,scaling_min_freq,$(cat $base/scaling_min_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,scaling_max_freq,$(cat $base/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,scaling_cur_freq,$(cat $base/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,cpuinfo_min_freq,$(cat $base/cpuinfo_min_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,cpuinfo_max_freq,$(cat $base/cpuinfo_max_freq 2>/dev/null)"

    # walt 自适应（关键！）
    local walt="$base/walt"
    echo "$tag,$policy,walt_adaptive_high,$(cat $walt/adaptive_high_freq 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
    echo "$tag,$policy,walt_adaptive_low,$(cat $walt/adaptive_low_freq 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
    echo "$tag,$policy,walt_boost,$(cat $walt/boost 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"

    # msm_performance
    local msm="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters"
    echo "$tag,$policy,msm_cpu_max,$(cat $msm/cpu_max_freq 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
    echo "$tag,$policy,msm_cpu_min,$(cat $msm/cpu_min_freq 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"

    # core_ctl（大核热插拔）
    local policy_num=$(echo "$policy" | sed 's/policy//')
    for cpu_dir in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu${policy_num}*; do
        cpu_name=$(basename "$cpu_dir")
        ctl="$cpu_dir/core_ctl"
        if [ -d "$ctl" ]; then
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_online,$(cat $cpu_dir/online 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_busy_up,$(cat $ctl/busy_up_thres 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_busy_down,$(cat $ctl/busy_down_thres 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_offline_delay,$(cat $ctl/offline_delay_ms 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_is_busy,$(cat $ctl/is_busy 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_not_preferred,$(cat $ctl/not_preferred 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
        fi
    done

    # thermal 限制
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if echo "$type" | grep -qi "cpu"; then
            echo "$tag,$policy,thermal_${type}_temp,$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)"
        fi
    done
    ) >> "$DIAG_FILE"
}

# ============================================
# 频率控制
# ============================================

set_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    # diag: 写入前
    diag_dump_policy "$policy" "before_set_${freq}"

    # 1. walt 自适应
    local walt="$base/walt"
    if [ -d "$walt" ]; then
        lock_value 0 "$walt/adaptive_high_freq"
        lock_value 0 "$walt/adaptive_low_freq"
        log "  walt自适应: 已禁用"
    else
        log "  walt目录: 不存在 ($walt)"
    fi

    # 2. scaling_max_freq
    log "  sysfs写入前: max_freq=$(cat $base/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    lock_value "$freq" "$base/scaling_max_freq"
    local actual_max=$(cat "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  sysfs写入后: max_freq=$actual_max (目标$freq)"

    # 3. 如果 max_freq 没写进去，尝试 force unlock + write
    if [ "$actual_max" != "$freq" ]; then
        log "  ⚠ max_freq 写入失败! 尝试 chattr -i 解锁..."
        chattr -i "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        actual_max=$(cat "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        log "  重试后: max_freq=$actual_max"
    fi

    # 4. msm_performance
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        # 写入所有 CPU 为最大值: "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 ..."
        echo "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 2:4294967295 3:4294967295 4:4294967295 5:4294967295 6:4294967295 7:4294967295" > "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 5. 温控限制解除
    local t_msg="/sys/class/thermal/thermal_message"
    if [ -f "$t_msg/cpu_limits" ]; then
        chmod 644 "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
        local max_cpuinfo=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        for cpu in $(seq 0 7); do
            echo "cpu$cpu $max_cpuinfo" > "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
        done
    fi

    # diag: 写入后
    diag_dump_policy "$policy" "after_set_${freq}"
}

restore_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    if [ -d "$base/walt" ]; then
        lock_value 1 "$base/walt/adaptive_high_freq"
        lock_value 1 "$base/walt/adaptive_low_freq"
    fi

    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    lock_value "$max_avail" "$base/scaling_max_freq"

    local msm="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$msm" 2>/dev/null
        echo "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 2:4294967295 3:4294967295 4:4294967295 5:4294967295 6:4294967295 7:4294967295" > "$msm" 2>/dev/null
    fi
}

# ============================================
# 屏幕控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && raw=$((0 - raw))
    echo "$raw"
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local t=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            [ -n "$t" ] && [ "$t" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null && echo $((t / 1000)) && return
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    local sec=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f1)
    local frac=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f2 | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

get_cur_freq() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null || echo "0"
}

get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        sum=$((sum + $(read_current)))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# CPU-bound 工作负载（v5：busybox sha256sum）
# 策略：在 tmpfs 上生成数据文件，反复 sha256sum
# sha256sum 是纯 CPU 计算，频率提升 → 性能线性提升
# ============================================

WORKLOAD_FILE="/dev/shm/bench_data"

prepare_workload() {
    log "准备 workload: busybox sha256sum..."
    if [ ! -x "$BUSYBOX" ]; then
        log "  警告: $BUSYBOX 不可执行，尝试 chmod..."
        chmod 755 "$BUSYBOX" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 生成测试数据到 tmpfs（内存文件系统，无 I/O 瓶颈）
    # 4MB 数据：足够大让 sha256sum 有活干，又不会超出 L3 cache 太多
    dd if=/dev/zero of="$WORKLOAD_FILE" bs=1M count=4 2>/dev/null
    log "  测试文件: $WORKLOAD_FILE (4MB, tmpfs)"

    # 验证 busybox sha256sum 可用
    if "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        log "  ✓ busybox sha256sum 可用"
    else
        log "  ✗ busybox sha256sum 不可用!"
        log "  尝试备选: busybox md5sum"
        if "$BUSYBOX" md5sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            log "  ✓ busybox md5sum 可用"
            HASH_CMD="md5sum"
        else
            log "  ✗ 无可用 hash 命令，退出"
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    log ""
}

# ============================================
# 校准（v5：用 busybox sha256sum 做校准）
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准 workload..."
    set_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    sleep "$SETTLE_SEC"

    log "  当前频率: $(( $(get_cur_freq $MID_POLICY) / 1000 ))MHz"

    # 测单次 sha256sum 4MB 耗时
    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
    "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local single_ms=$((t2 - t1))

    # 测 10 次耗时（验证线性）
    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt 10 ]; do
        "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ten_ms=$((t4 - t3))

    log "  单次: ${single_ms}ms | 10次: ${ten_ms}ms | 平均: $((ten_ms / 10))ms/次"

    # 目标：每轮 ~50ms → 需要几次 hash？
    local hashes_per_50ms=$((50 * 10 / (ten_ms + 1)))
    [ "$hashes_per_50ms" -lt 1 ] && hashes_per_50ms=1
    [ "$hashes_per_50ms" -gt 100 ] && hashes_per_50ms=100

    log "  每轮 hash 次数: $hashes_per_50ms (目标 ~50ms/轮)"
    log ""
    WORKLOAD_HASHES=$hashes_per_50ms

    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "── 测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz ──"

    # === 设置频率上限 ===
    set_cpu_max "$policy" "$freq"
    sleep "$SETTLE_SEC"

    # 绑定 CPU
    taskset -p "$cpus" $$ 2>/dev/null

    # 预热一轮
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $((WORKLOAD_HASHES)) ]; do
        "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    sleep 0.5

    # 实际频率
    local actual_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$policy")
    log "  目标=${freq_mhz}MHz 实际=$((actual_freq/1000))MHz"

    # 基线电流
    log "  基线采样 (${CURRENT_SAMPLES}次)..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current $CURRENT_SAMPLES)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 跑负载
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
    local total_hashes=0
    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
        "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1
        total_hashes=$((total_hashes + 1))
    done
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    # 负载电流
    log "  负载采样 (${CURRENT_SAMPLES}次)..."
    local load_current=$(sample_current $CURRENT_SAMPLES)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    # 性能 = 每秒 hash 次数
    local hash_per_sec=0
    [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ] && hash_per_sec=$((total_hashes * 1000 / elapsed_ms))

    # 能效比 = 每毫瓦的 hash/秒 * 100
    local efficiency=0
    [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ] && efficiency=$((hash_per_sec * 100 / power_mw))

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$hash_per_sec,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 性能=${hash_per_sec} hash/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=${efficiency} | ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"

    # 频率有效性判定
    local freq_deviation=$((actual_freq * 100 / (freq + 1)))
    if [ "$freq_deviation" -lt 80 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 频率偏差过大! (${freq_deviation}% 目标)"
    fi

    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v5"
    log "  workload: busybox sha256sum (4MB tmpfs)"
    log "  策略: 限制 max_freq + CPU负载自动推满"
    log "=========================================="

    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        exit 1
    fi

    # SELinux
    local selinux_orig=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ]; then
        setenforce 0
        log "SELinux: Enforcing → Permissive"
    fi

    # 解锁 msm_performance
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 屏幕控制
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null

    log "中核: cpu$MID_CPUS | 大核: cpu$BIG_CPUS"

    [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ] && settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ] && settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v5
# 改进：
#   1. busybox sha256sum 做真正 CPU-bound 负载（替代 shell 算术）
#   2. 大核诊断：每个测试点前后 dump sysfs，定位频率不生效原因
#   3. 采样增加 + settle 期，减少基线波动
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/energy_bench_v5.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v5_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v5_${TIMESTAMP}.log"
DIAG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v5_${TIMESTAMP}_diag.csv"

# ============================================
# 路径配置
# ============================================
BUSYBOX="/data/data/com.omarea.vtools/files/busybox"
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS="0-5"
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS="6-7"

BENCH_DURATION=10
COOL_DOWN=5
CURRENT_SAMPLES=5       # 从 3 增加到 5
SETTLE_SEC=2            # 频率切换后的稳定期

# ============================================
# sysfs 写入函数（复用 Scene 的 lock_value 技巧）
# ============================================

lock_value() {
    local value=$1
    local path=$2
    if [ -f "$path" ]; then
        chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
        echo "$value" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 444 "$path" 2>/dev/null
    fi
}

set_value() {
    local value=$1
    local path=$2
    if [ -f "$path" ]; then
        local current=$(cat "$path" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$current" != "$value" ]; then
            chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
            echo "$value" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        fi
    fi
}

# ============================================
# 诊断：dump 一个 policy 的所有相关 sysfs（定位大核问题）
# ============================================

diag_dump_policy() {
    local policy=$1
    local tag=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    (
    echo "$tag,$policy,scaling_governor,$(cat $base/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,scaling_min_freq,$(cat $base/scaling_min_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,scaling_max_freq,$(cat $base/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,scaling_cur_freq,$(cat $base/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,cpuinfo_min_freq,$(cat $base/cpuinfo_min_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    echo "$tag,$policy,cpuinfo_max_freq,$(cat $base/cpuinfo_max_freq 2>/dev/null)"

    # walt 自适应（关键！）
    local walt="$base/walt"
    echo "$tag,$policy,walt_adaptive_high,$(cat $walt/adaptive_high_freq 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
    echo "$tag,$policy,walt_adaptive_low,$(cat $walt/adaptive_low_freq 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
    echo "$tag,$policy,walt_boost,$(cat $walt/boost 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"

    # msm_performance
    local msm="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters"
    echo "$tag,$policy,msm_cpu_max,$(cat $msm/cpu_max_freq 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"
    echo "$tag,$policy,msm_cpu_min,$(cat $msm/cpu_min_freq 2>/dev/null || echo 'N/A')"

    # core_ctl（大核热插拔）
    local policy_num=$(echo "$policy" | sed 's/policy//')
    for cpu_dir in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu${policy_num}*; do
        cpu_name=$(basename "$cpu_dir")
        ctl="$cpu_dir/core_ctl"
        if [ -d "$ctl" ]; then
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_online,$(cat $cpu_dir/online 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_busy_up,$(cat $ctl/busy_up_thres 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_busy_down,$(cat $ctl/busy_down_thres 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_offline_delay,$(cat $ctl/offline_delay_ms 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_is_busy,$(cat $ctl/is_busy 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
            echo "$tag,$policy,core_ctl_${cpu_name}_not_preferred,$(cat $ctl/not_preferred 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
        fi
    done

    # thermal 限制
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if echo "$type" | grep -qi "cpu"; then
            echo "$tag,$policy,thermal_${type}_temp,$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)"
        fi
    done
    ) >> "$DIAG_FILE"
}

# ============================================
# 频率控制
# ============================================

set_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    # diag: 写入前
    diag_dump_policy "$policy" "before_set_${freq}"

    # 1. walt 自适应
    local walt="$base/walt"
    if [ -d "$walt" ]; then
        lock_value 0 "$walt/adaptive_high_freq"
        lock_value 0 "$walt/adaptive_low_freq"
        log "  walt自适应: 已禁用"
    else
        log "  walt目录: 不存在 ($walt)"
    fi

    # 2. scaling_max_freq
    log "  sysfs写入前: max_freq=$(cat $base/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    lock_value "$freq" "$base/scaling_max_freq"
    local actual_max=$(cat "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  sysfs写入后: max_freq=$actual_max (目标$freq)"

    # 3. 如果 max_freq 没写进去，尝试 force unlock + write
    if [ "$actual_max" != "$freq" ]; then
        log "  ⚠ max_freq 写入失败! 尝试 chattr -i 解锁..."
        chattr -i "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        actual_max=$(cat "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        log "  重试后: max_freq=$actual_max"
    fi

    # 4. msm_performance
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        # 写入所有 CPU 为最大值: "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 ..."
        echo "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 2:4294967295 3:4294967295 4:4294967295 5:4294967295 6:4294967295 7:4294967295" > "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 5. 温控限制解除
    local t_msg="/sys/class/thermal/thermal_message"
    if [ -f "$t_msg/cpu_limits" ]; then
        chmod 644 "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
        local max_cpuinfo=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        for cpu in $(seq 0 7); do
            echo "cpu$cpu $max_cpuinfo" > "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
        done
    fi

    # diag: 写入后
    diag_dump_policy "$policy" "after_set_${freq}"
}

restore_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    if [ -d "$base/walt" ]; then
        lock_value 1 "$base/walt/adaptive_high_freq"
        lock_value 1 "$base/walt/adaptive_low_freq"
    fi

    local max_avail=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    lock_value "$max_avail" "$base/scaling_max_freq"

    local msm="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$msm" 2>/dev/null
        echo "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 2:4294967295 3:4294967295 4:4294967295 5:4294967295 6:4294967295 7:4294967295" > "$msm" 2>/dev/null
    fi
}

# ============================================
# 屏幕控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && raw=$((0 - raw))
    echo "$raw"
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        if [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-0" ] || [ "$type" = "cpuss-0-1" ]; then
            local t=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
            [ -n "$t" ] && [ "$t" -gt 10000 ] 2>/dev/null && echo $((t / 1000)) && return
        fi
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    local sec=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f1)
    local frac=$(echo "$uptime" | cut -d'.' -f2 | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

get_cur_freq() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_cur_freq" 2>/dev/null || echo "0"
}

get_available_freqs() {
    cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies" 2>/dev/null
}

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        sum=$((sum + $(read_current)))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# CPU-bound 工作负载（v5：busybox sha256sum）
# 策略：在 tmpfs 上生成数据文件，反复 sha256sum
# sha256sum 是纯 CPU 计算，频率提升 → 性能线性提升
# ============================================

WORKLOAD_FILE="/dev/shm/bench_data"

prepare_workload() {
    log "准备 workload: busybox sha256sum..."
    if [ ! -x "$BUSYBOX" ]; then
        log "  警告: $BUSYBOX 不可执行，尝试 chmod..."
        chmod 755 "$BUSYBOX" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 生成测试数据到 tmpfs（内存文件系统，无 I/O 瓶颈）
    # 4MB 数据：足够大让 sha256sum 有活干，又不会超出 L3 cache 太多
    dd if=/dev/zero of="$WORKLOAD_FILE" bs=1M count=4 2>/dev/null
    log "  测试文件: $WORKLOAD_FILE (4MB, tmpfs)"

    # 验证 busybox sha256sum 可用
    if "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        log "  ✓ busybox sha256sum 可用"
    else
        log "  ✗ busybox sha256sum 不可用!"
        log "  尝试备选: busybox md5sum"
        if "$BUSYBOX" md5sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            log "  ✓ busybox md5sum 可用"
            HASH_CMD="md5sum"
        else
            log "  ✗ 无可用 hash 命令，退出"
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    log ""
}

# ============================================
# 校准（v5：用 busybox sha256sum 做校准）
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准 workload..."
    set_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    sleep "$SETTLE_SEC"

    log "  当前频率: $(( $(get_cur_freq $MID_POLICY) / 1000 ))MHz"

    # 测单次 sha256sum 4MB 耗时
    local t1=$(get_time_ms)
    "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1
    local t2=$(get_time_ms)
    local single_ms=$((t2 - t1))

    # 测 10 次耗时（验证线性）
    local t3=$(get_time_ms)
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt 10 ]; do
        "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    local t4=$(get_time_ms)
    local ten_ms=$((t4 - t3))

    log "  单次: ${single_ms}ms | 10次: ${ten_ms}ms | 平均: $((ten_ms / 10))ms/次"

    # 目标：每轮 ~50ms → 需要几次 hash？
    local hashes_per_50ms=$((50 * 10 / (ten_ms + 1)))
    [ "$hashes_per_50ms" -lt 1 ] && hashes_per_50ms=1
    [ "$hashes_per_50ms" -gt 100 ] && hashes_per_50ms=100

    log "  每轮 hash 次数: $hashes_per_50ms (目标 ~50ms/轮)"
    log ""
    WORKLOAD_HASHES=$hashes_per_50ms

    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    log "── 测试: $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz ──"

    # === 设置频率上限 ===
    set_cpu_max "$policy" "$freq"
    sleep "$SETTLE_SEC"

    # 绑定 CPU
    taskset -p "$cpus" $$ 2>/dev/null

    # 预热一轮
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $((WORKLOAD_HASHES)) ]; do
        "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    sleep 0.5

    # 实际频率
    local actual_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$policy")
    log "  目标=${freq_mhz}MHz 实际=$((actual_freq/1000))MHz"

    # 基线电流
    log "  基线采样 (${CURRENT_SAMPLES}次)..."
    local base_current=$(sample_current $CURRENT_SAMPLES)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 跑负载
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local end_ms=$((start_ms + BENCH_DURATION * 1000))
    local total_hashes=0
    while [ $(get_time_ms) -lt $end_ms ]; do
        "$BUSYBOX" sha256sum "$WORKLOAD_FILE" > /dev/null 2>&1
        total_hashes=$((total_hashes + 1))
    done
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))

    # 负载电流
    log "  负载采样 (${CURRENT_SAMPLES}次)..."
    local load_current=$(sample_current $CURRENT_SAMPLES)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    # 性能 = 每秒 hash 次数
    local hash_per_sec=0
    [ "$elapsed_ms" -gt 0 ] && hash_per_sec=$((total_hashes * 1000 / elapsed_ms))

    # 能效比 = 每毫瓦的 hash/秒 * 100
    local efficiency=0
    [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ] && efficiency=$((hash_per_sec * 100 / power_mw))

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$hash_per_sec,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  结果: 性能=${hash_per_sec} hash/s 功耗=${power_mw}mW 能效比=${efficiency} | ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"

    # 频率有效性判定
    local freq_deviation=$((actual_freq * 100 / (freq + 1)))
    if [ "$freq_deviation" -lt 80 ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 频率偏差过大! (${freq_deviation}% 目标)"
    fi

    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v5"
    log "  workload: busybox sha256sum (4MB tmpfs)"
    log "  策略: 限制 max_freq + CPU负载自动推满"
    log "=========================================="

    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        exit 1
    fi

    # SELinux
    local selinux_orig=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ]; then
        setenforce 0
        log "SELinux: Enforcing → Permissive"
    fi

    # 解锁 msm_performance
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 屏幕控制
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null

    log "中核: cpu$MID_CPUS | 大核: cpu$BIG_CPUS"
    log "Governor: $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null)"
    log "Busybox: $BUSYBOX"
    log "初始温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log ""

    # 准备 workload + 校准
    prepare_workload
    calibrate

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,性能hash/s,能效比" > "$RESULT_FILE"
    echo "阶段,Policy,项目,值" > "$DIAG_FILE"

    log "CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "DIAG: $DIAG_FILE"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 中核组
    # ============================================
    log "========== 中核组 (cpu$MID_CPUS) =========="
    local mid_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $MID_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$MID_POLICY" "$freq" "$MID_CPUS" "中核" && mid_ok=$((mid_ok + 1))
    done
    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
    log "中核完成: $mid_ok"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 大核组
    # ============================================
    log "========== 大核组 (cpu$BIG_CPUS) =========="
    local big_ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $BIG_POLICY); do
        run_single_test "$BIG_POLICY" "$freq" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核" && big_ok=$((big_ok + 1))
    done
    restore_cpu_max "$BIG_POLICY"
    log "大核完成: $big_ok"
    log ""

    # ============================================
    # 恢复
    # ============================================
    [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ] && settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ] && settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ] && setenforce 1
    rm -f "$WORKLOAD_FILE"

    log "=========================================="
    log "  完成! 温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "  中核: $mid_ok | 大核: $big_ok"
    log "  CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "  DIAG: $DIAG_FILE  ← 大核频率诊断数据"
    log "=========================================="
}

main "$@"

## v5 的三个关键修正

| | v4（问题） | v5（修正） |
|---|---|---|
| **workload** | shell `$((...))` 循环，开销全在解释器 | busybox sha256sum 4MB tmpfs，纯 CPU 计算 |
| **大核诊断** | 无 | 每个频率点前后 dump sysfs → `_diag.csv` |
| **基线采样** | 3 次、无 settle | 5 次、频率切换后 settle 2s |

### v5 新增的诊断文件

跑完后会多一个 `_diag.csv`，每个频率点记录：

```
阶段, Policy, 项目, 值
before_set_1500000, policy6, scaling_max_freq, 4320000
before_set_1500000, policy6, walt_adaptive_high, 1
...
after_set_1500000, policy6, scaling_max_freq, 1500000  ← 看这行
after_set_1500000, policy6, walt_adaptive_high, 0
```

**重点关注大核 `after_set` 的 `scaling_max_freq` 值**——如果它显示写入了但 `scaling_cur_freq` 还是不上去，说明有别的东西在覆盖（温控、core_ctl、msm_performance）。如果它根本没写进去，说明 sysfs 接口本身被锁了。

连上手机后：

```bash
adb push 能耗比测试\energy_bench_v5.sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/
adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/energy_bench_v5.sh'
# 跑完后拉回三个文件：CSV、LOG、DIAG
```

content: 正在做骁龙8至尊版的能耗比测试。v4 发现大核频率锁不住、shell 负载不跟频率走，刚写了 v5：换 busybox sha256sum 做真 CPU 负载，加了每个频率点的 sysfs 诊断。连上手机后推送 v5 跑一次就行。 (disable recaps in /config)

Key observations from this module:

1. **It writes per-CPU, not per-policy**: It uses `/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_max_freq` instead of `/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_max_freq`. Both should be the same (symlinks typically), but this is a different approach.

2. **No fancy tricks**: Just `chmod 644` + `echo`. No lock_value, no hide_value, no walt manipulation, no thermal bypassing.

3. **It targets Snapdragon 8 Gen 3**, but the approach should work similarly for 8 Gen 1 (骁龙8至尊版).

   - 5大核 (cpu2-6): capped at 2630MHz

set_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    # diag: 写入前
    diag_dump_policy "$policy" "before_set_${freq}"

    # 1. walt 自适应
    local walt="$base/walt"
    if [ -d "$walt" ]; then
        lock_value 0 "$walt/adaptive_high_freq"
        lock_value 0 "$walt/adaptive_low_freq"
        log "  walt自适应: 已禁用"
    else
        log "  walt目录: 不存在 ($walt)"
    fi

    # 2. scaling_max_freq
    log "  sysfs写入前: max_freq=$(cat $base/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)"
    lock_value "$freq" "$base/scaling_max_freq"
    local actual_max=$(cat "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  sysfs写入后: max_freq=$actual_max (目标$freq)"

    # 3. 如果 max_freq 没写进去，尝试 force unlock + write
    if [ "$actual_max" != "$freq" ]; then
        log "  ⚠ max_freq 写入失败! 尝试 chattr -i 解锁..."
        chattr -i "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        actual_max=$(cat "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        log "  重试后: max_freq=$actual_max"
    fi

    # 4. msm_performance
    local msm_max="/sys/module/msm_performance/parameters/cpu_max_freq"
    if [ -f "$msm_max" ]; then
        chattr -i "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
        # 写入所有 CPU 为最大值: "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 ..."
        echo "0:4294967295 1:4294967295 2:4294967295 3:4294967295 4:4294967295 5:4294967295 6:4294967295 7:4294967295" > "$msm_max" 2>/dev/null
    fi

    # 5. 温控限制解除
    local t_msg="/sys/class/thermal/thermal_message"
    if [ -f "$t_msg/cpu_limits" ]; then
        chmod 644 "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
        local max_cpuinfo=$(cat "$base/cpuinfo_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        for cpu in $(seq 0 7); do
            echo "cpu$cpu $max_cpuinfo" > "$t_msg/cpu_limits" 2>/dev/null
        done
    fi

    # diag: 写入后
    diag_dump_policy "$policy" "after_set_${freq}"
}

set_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local base="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy"

    # diag: 写入前
    diag_dump_policy "$policy" "before_set_${freq}"

    # 获取该 policy 下的 CPU 列表
    local affected=$(cat "$base/affected_cpus" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  affected_cpus: $affected"

    # === 参考 8Gen3限频模块的做法：per-CPU 路径写入 ===
    log "  写入前: policy_max=$(cat $base/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)"

    for cpu in $affected; do
        local cpu_path="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu$cpu/cpufreq/scaling_max_freq"
        if [ -f "$cpu_path" ]; then
            chmod 644 "$cpu_path" 2>/dev/null
            echo "$freq" > "$cpu_path" 2>/dev/null
            local written=$(cat "$cpu_path" 2>/dev/null)
            log "  cpu$cpu: 写入$freq, 实际=$written"
        fi
    done

    # 验证：读回 policy 级别 max_freq
    local actual_max=$(cat "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
    log "  写入后: policy_max=$actual_max (目标$freq)"

    # 如果仍然不一致，尝试 force policy 路径
    if [ "$actual_max" != "$freq" ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 不一致! 尝试 chattr -i + policy路径强制写入..."
        chattr -i "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        chmod 644 "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        echo "$freq" > "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null
        actual_max=$(cat "$base/scaling_max_freq" 2>/dev/null)
        log "  重试后: policy_max=$actual_max"
    fi

    # diag: 写入后
    diag_dump_policy "$policy" "after_set_${freq}"
}

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v6
# 频率控制：完全参考 8Gen3限频模块 (per-CPU chmod+echo)
# 负载：多进程纯 shell 算术，填满所有核
# 零依赖：不依赖 busybox 或任何外部工具
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/energy_bench_v6.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v6_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v6_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

# ============================================
# CPU 配置
# ============================================
# 中核组
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/affected_cpus 2>/dev/null || echo "0-5")
# 大核组
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/affected_cpus 2>/dev/null || echo "6-7")

BENCH_DURATION=10
COOL_DOWN=5
CURRENT_SAMPLES=5
SETTLE_SEC=1

# ============================================
# 屏幕控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# ============================================
# 频率控制（完全参考 8Gen3限频模块 v4）
# ============================================

set_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local affected=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/affected_cpus 2>/dev/null)

    # === 参考模块做法：per-CPU chmod 644 + echo ===
    for cpu in $affected; do
        local path="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu$cpu/cpufreq/scaling_max_freq"
        if [ -f "$path" ]; then
            chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
            echo "$freq" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        fi
    done

    # 验证
    local actual=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)
    log "  max_freq: $freq → $actual"
}

restore_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local max=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/cpuinfo_max_freq 2>/dev/null)
    local affected=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/affected_cpus 2>/dev/null)

    for cpu in $affected; do
        local path="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu$cpu/cpufreq/scaling_max_freq"
        if [ -f "$path" ]; then
            chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
            echo "$max" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        fi
    done
}

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && raw=$((0 - raw))
    echo "$raw"
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        case "$type" in
            cpuss-0-0|cpuss-0-1)
                local t=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
                [ -n "$t" ] && [ "$t" -gt 1000 ] 2>/dev/null && echo $((t / 1000)) && return
                ;;
        esac
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    # 不依赖 awk（有些系统没有），用 read 分割
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null)
    local sec="${uptime%%.*}"
    local frac="${uptime#*.}"
    frac="${frac%% *}"
    frac=$(echo "$frac" | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

get_cur_freq() {
    cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null || echo "0"
}

get_available_freqs() {
    cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies 2>/dev/null
}

count_cpus() {
    local cpus=$1
    local count=0
    for cpu in $cpus; do
        count=$((count + 1))
    done
    echo $count
}

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        sum=$((sum + $(read_current)))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# CPU 负载（v6：多进程纯 shell 算术）
# 策略：fork N 个子进程（N = 该组 CPU 核数）
#       每个子进程做纯整数算术，不接触内存/IO
#       频率提升 = 更多迭代 = 性能线性增长
# ============================================

# 全局 PID 数组
WORKER_PIDS=""

start_workers() {
    local num_workers=$1

    local w=0
    while [ $w -lt $num_workers ]; do
        (
            # LCG 伪随机数生成器 —— 纯 ALU，无内存访问
            # x = (x * a + c) mod m
            local x=$((1000 + w * 777))
            while true; do
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
            done
        ) &
        WORKER_PIDS="$WORKER_PIDS $!"
        w=$((w + 1))
    done
}

stop_workers() {
    for pid in $WORKER_PIDS; do
        kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
    done
    wait $WORKER_PIDS 2>/dev/null
    WORKER_PIDS=""
}

# ============================================
# 校准：找个能跑出差异的频率来验证
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准..."

    set_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    sleep $SETTLE_SEC

    local worker_count=$(count_cpus "$MID_CPUS")
    log "  中核数: $worker_count"

    # 跑 2 秒，看每秒能做多少轮
    start_workers $worker_count
    sleep 2
    stop_workers

    # 粗略判断可用性
    local cur_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$MID_POLICY")
    log "  当前频率: $((cur_freq/1000))MHz"
    log "  workload: ${worker_count}个纯算术进程 (LCG)"
    log ""

    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    local worker_count=$(count_cpus "$cpus")

    log "── $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz (${worker_count}核) ──"

    # === 设置上限 ===
    set_cpu_max "$policy" "$freq"
    sleep $SETTLE_SEC

    # 绑定脚本到目标 CPU
    taskset -p "0-$((worker_count - 1))" $$ 2>/dev/null

    # 预热 1s
    start_workers $worker_count
    sleep 1
    stop_workers
    sleep 0.3

    local actual_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$policy")
    log "  目标=${freq_mhz}MHz 实际=$((actual_freq/1000))MHz"

    # 基线电流
    local base_current=$(sample_current $CURRENT_SAMPLES)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 跑负载（按核数启动 worker）
    start_workers $worker_count
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s (${worker_count} workers)..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    sleep $BENCH_DURATION
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))
    stop_workers

    # 负载电流
    local load_current=$(sample_current $CURRENT_SAMPLES)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算功耗
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    # 性能：用 CPU 时间（elapsed × worker数）作为工作量估计
    # 由于 worker 是 100% CPU-bound，实际工作量 ∝ 频率 × 时间 × 核数
    local cpu_work=$((elapsed_ms * worker_count * actual_freq / 1000000))

    # 能效比 = cpu_work / power
    local efficiency=0
    [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ] && efficiency=$((cpu_work * 10 / power_mw))

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$worker_count,$cpu_work,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  功耗=${power_mw}mW 效率分=${efficiency} | ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"

    # 频率偏差告警
    if [ "$actual_freq" -lt $((freq * 80 / 100)) ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 实际频率远低于目标!"
    fi

    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
}

# ============================================
# 运行一个 policy 的所有频率
# ============================================

run_policy_tests() {
    local policy=$1
    local cpus=$2
    local label=$3

    log "========== $label ($policy: cpu$cpus) =========="
    local ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $policy); do
        run_single_test "$policy" "$freq" "$cpus" "$label" && ok=$((ok + 1))
    done
    restore_cpu_max "$policy"
    log "$label 完成: $ok 个"
    log ""
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v6"
    log "  频率控制: 参考 8Gen3限频模块 (per-CPU)"

#!/system/bin/sh
# ============================================
# 骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v6
# 频率控制：完全参考 8Gen3限频模块 (per-CPU chmod+echo)
# 负载：多进程纯 shell 算术，填满所有核
# 零依赖：不依赖 busybox 或任何外部工具
# 运行：adb shell su -c 'sh /sdcard/能耗比测试/energy_bench_v6.sh'
# ============================================

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RESULT_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v6_${TIMESTAMP}.csv"
LOG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/energy_bench_v6_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

# ============================================
# CPU 配置
# ============================================
# 中核组
MID_POLICY="policy0"
MID_CPUS=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/affected_cpus 2>/dev/null || echo "0-5")
# 大核组
BIG_POLICY="policy6"
BIG_CPUS=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy6/affected_cpus 2>/dev/null || echo "6-7")

BENCH_DURATION=10
COOL_DOWN=5
CURRENT_SAMPLES=5
SETTLE_SEC=1

# ============================================
# 屏幕控制
# ============================================
SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT=$(settings get system screen_off_timeout 2>/dev/null)
SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS=$(settings get system screen_brightness 2>/dev/null)

# ============================================
# 频率控制（完全参考 8Gen3限频模块 v4）
# ============================================

set_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local affected=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/affected_cpus 2>/dev/null)

    # === 参考模块做法：per-CPU chmod 644 + echo ===
    for cpu in $affected; do
        local path="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu$cpu/cpufreq/scaling_max_freq"
        if [ -f "$path" ]; then
            chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
            echo "$freq" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        fi
    done

    # 验证
    local actual=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null)
    log "  max_freq: $freq → $actual"
}

restore_cpu_max() {
    local policy=$1
    local max=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/cpuinfo_max_freq 2>/dev/null)
    local affected=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$policy/affected_cpus 2>/dev/null)

    for cpu in $affected; do
        local path="/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu$cpu/cpufreq/scaling_max_freq"
        if [ -f "$path" ]; then
            chmod 644 "$path" 2>/dev/null
            echo "$max" > "$path" 2>/dev/null
        fi
    done
}

# ============================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================

log() {
    local msg="[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $1"
    echo "$msg"
    echo "$msg" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

read_current() {
    local raw=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_now 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    [ "$raw" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && raw=$((0 - raw))
    echo "$raw"
}

read_voltage() {
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null || echo "3800000"
}

read_temp() {
    for tz in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/; do
        local type=$(cat ${tz}type 2>/dev/null)
        case "$type" in
            cpuss-0-0|cpuss-0-1)
                local t=$(cat ${tz}temp 2>/dev/null)
                [ -n "$t" ] && [ "$t" -gt 1000 ] 2>/dev/null && echo $((t / 1000)) && return
                ;;
        esac
    done
    echo "0"
}

get_time_ms() {
    # 不依赖 awk（有些系统没有），用 read 分割
    local uptime=$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null)
    local sec="${uptime%%.*}"
    local frac="${uptime#*.}"
    frac="${frac%% *}"
    frac=$(echo "$frac" | cut -c1-2)
    [ -z "$frac" ] && frac="0"
    [ ${#frac} -eq 1 ] && frac="${frac}0"
    echo $((sec * 1000 + frac * 10))
}

get_cur_freq() {
    cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null || echo "0"
}

get_available_freqs() {
    cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$1/scaling_available_frequencies 2>/dev/null
}

count_cpus() {
    local cpus=$1
    local count=0
    for cpu in $cpus; do
        count=$((count + 1))
    done
    echo $count
}

sample_current() {
    local samples=$1
    local sum=0
    local i=0
    while [ $i -lt $samples ]; do
        sum=$((sum + $(read_current)))
        sleep 0.3
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo $((sum / samples))
}

# ============================================
# CPU 负载（v6：多进程纯 shell 算术）
# 策略：fork N 个子进程（N = 该组 CPU 核数）
#       每个子进程做纯整数算术，不接触内存/IO
#       频率提升 = 更多迭代 = 性能线性增长
# ============================================

# 全局 PID 数组
WORKER_PIDS=""

start_workers() {
    local num_workers=$1

    local w=0
    while [ $w -lt $num_workers ]; do
        (
            # LCG 伪随机数生成器 —— 纯 ALU，无内存访问
            # x = (x * a + c) mod m
            local x=$((1000 + w * 777))
            while true; do
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
                x=$(( (x * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF ))
            done
        ) &
        WORKER_PIDS="$WORKER_PIDS $!"
        w=$((w + 1))
    done
}

stop_workers() {
    for pid in $WORKER_PIDS; do
        kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
    done
    wait $WORKER_PIDS 2>/dev/null
    WORKER_PIDS=""
}

# ============================================
# 校准：找个能跑出差异的频率来验证
# ============================================

calibrate() {
    log "校准..."

    set_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY" 1996000
    sleep $SETTLE_SEC

    local worker_count=$(count_cpus "$MID_CPUS")
    log "  中核数: $worker_count"

    # 跑 2 秒，看每秒能做多少轮
    start_workers $worker_count
    sleep 2
    stop_workers

    # 粗略判断可用性
    local cur_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$MID_POLICY")
    log "  当前频率: $((cur_freq/1000))MHz"
    log "  workload: ${worker_count}个纯算术进程 (LCG)"
    log ""

    restore_cpu_max "$MID_POLICY"
}

# ============================================
# 单次测试
# ============================================

run_single_test() {
    local policy=$1
    local freq=$2
    local cpus=$3
    local label="$4"

    local freq_mhz=$((freq / 1000))
    local worker_count=$(count_cpus "$cpus")

    log "── $label @ ${freq_mhz}MHz (${worker_count}核) ──"

    # === 设置上限 ===
    set_cpu_max "$policy" "$freq"
    sleep $SETTLE_SEC

    # 绑定脚本到目标 CPU
    taskset -p "0-$((worker_count - 1))" $$ 2>/dev/null

    # 预热 1s
    start_workers $worker_count
    sleep 1
    stop_workers
    sleep 0.3

    local actual_freq=$(get_cur_freq "$policy")
    log "  目标=${freq_mhz}MHz 实际=$((actual_freq/1000))MHz"

    # 基线电流
    local base_current=$(sample_current $CURRENT_SAMPLES)
    local base_temp=$(read_temp)

    # 跑负载（按核数启动 worker）
    start_workers $worker_count
    log "  负载 ${BENCH_DURATION}s (${worker_count} workers)..."
    local start_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    sleep $BENCH_DURATION
    local final_ms=$(get_time_ms)
    local elapsed_ms=$((final_ms - start_ms))
    stop_workers

    # 负载电流
    local load_current=$(sample_current $CURRENT_SAMPLES)
    local load_temp=$(read_temp)
    local voltage=$(read_voltage)

    # 计算功耗
    local delta_current=$((load_current - base_current))
    [ "$delta_current" -lt 0 ] && delta_current=0
    local ma=$((delta_current / 1000))
    local v=$((voltage / 1000000))
    local power_mw=$((ma * v))

    # 性能：用 CPU 时间（elapsed × worker数）作为工作量估计
    # 由于 worker 是 100% CPU-bound，实际工作量 ∝ 频率 × 时间 × 核数
    local cpu_work=$((elapsed_ms * worker_count * actual_freq / 1000000))

    # 能效比 = cpu_work / power
    local efficiency=0
    [ "$power_mw" -gt 0 ] && efficiency=$((cpu_work * 10 / power_mw))

    echo "$label,${freq_mhz},$actual_freq,$elapsed_ms,$base_current,$load_current,$delta_current,$power_mw,$base_temp,$load_temp,$worker_count,$cpu_work,$efficiency" >> "$RESULT_FILE"

    log "  功耗=${power_mw}mW 效率分=${efficiency} | ${base_temp}→${load_temp}°C"

    # 频率偏差告警
    if [ "$actual_freq" -lt $((freq * 80 / 100)) ]; then
        log "  ⚠ 实际频率远低于目标!"
    fi

    log "  冷却 ${COOL_DOWN}s..."
    sleep $COOL_DOWN
}

# ============================================
# 运行一个 policy 的所有频率
# ============================================

run_policy_tests() {
    local policy=$1
    local cpus=$2
    local label=$3

    log "========== $label ($policy: cpu$cpus) =========="
    local ok=0
    for freq in $(get_available_freqs $policy); do
        run_single_test "$policy" "$freq" "$cpus" "$label" && ok=$((ok + 1))
    done
    restore_cpu_max "$policy"
    log "$label 完成: $ok 个"
    log ""
}

# ============================================
# 主流程
# ============================================

main() {
    log "=========================================="
    log "  骁龙8至尊版 能耗比测试 v6"
    log "  频率控制: 参考 8Gen3限频模块 (per-CPU)"
    log "  负载: 多进程纯 shell 算术 (零依赖)"
    log "=========================================="

    if [ "$(id -u)" != "0" ]; then
        log "错误: 需要 Root 权限"
        exit 1
    fi

    # SELinux
    local selinux_orig=$(getenforce 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ]; then
        setenforce 0
        log "SELinux: Permissive"
    fi

    # 屏幕
    settings put system screen_off_timeout 2147483647 2>/dev/null
    settings put system screen_brightness 1 2>/dev/null

    log "中核: cpu$MID_CPUS (policy0)"
    log "大核: cpu$BIG_CPUS (policy6)"
    log "Governor: $(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/$MID_POLICY/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null)"
    log "零依赖模式 (无 busybox)"
    log "温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log ""

    # 校准
    calibrate

    # CSV 头
    echo "核心组,目标MHz,实际MHz,耗时ms,基线uA,负载uA,电流差uA,功耗mW,基线°C,负载°C,核数,工作量,效率分" > "$RESULT_FILE"
    log "CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log ""

    # 中核 + 大核
    run_policy_tests "$MID_POLICY" "$MID_CPUS" "中核"
    run_policy_tests "$BIG_POLICY" "$BIG_CPUS" "大核"

    # 恢复
    [ -n "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" ] && settings put system screen_off_timeout "$SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT" 2>/dev/null
    [ -n "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" ] && settings put system screen_brightness "$SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS" 2>/dev/null
    [ "$selinux_orig" = "Enforcing" ] && setenforce 1

    log "=========================================="
    log "  完成! 温度: $(read_temp)°C"
    log "  CSV: $RESULT_FILE"
    log "=========================================="
}

main "$@"
